wshuyi-remotion-video-skill.limit_en: Needs Node for the Remotion project and Python for the audio scripts. Narration prefers MiniMax TTS: an API key plus per-character billing, else it drops to Edge TTS fixed voices. 3D is capped by the browser's 8-16 WebGL contexts.
wshuyi-remotion-video-skill.title_en: Change one parameter, re-render the whole film

hoolulu-deep-research.title_zh: 十分钟出一份带出处的深度调研
hoolulu-deep-research.tagline_zh: 要判断一个行业或标的，自己查三天还不确定？多个智能体分工去查、互相交叉验证，十分钟给你一份券商体例、条条有出处的报告。
hoolulu-deep-research.tagline_en: One command, ten minutes, one brokerage-grade deep research report — multi-agent collaboration with automatic verification and cross-checking, fully sourced.
hoolulu-deep-research.why_zh: 敢喊「券商级」就得扛住，它靠的是多智能体分工加交叉验证，而不是一次生成一篇长文糊弄。
hoolulu-deep-research.why_en: Claiming brokerage grade sets a bar, and it meets it with divided agent labor and cross-verification rather than one long confident essay.
hoolulu-deep-research.limit_zh: 按 OpenCode 写的：Scrapling MCP 要注册进 opencode.json 再重启，另需 Python 3.10+ 和自建 SearXNG。可信评估那段被明令不许说「缺陷」「无法获取」、末句必须肯定。
hoolulu-deep-research.limit_en: Written for OpenCode: register the Scrapling MCP in opencode.json and restart, plus Python 3.10+ and a self-hosted SearXNG. Its confidence section is instructed never to say "flaw" or "unavailable" and to close on an affirmative note.
hoolulu-deep-research.title_en: Agents that fact-check each other, in ten minutes

blessonism-openclaw-search-skills-search.tagline_zh: 给 agent 的默认搜索层:多来源并发检索加去重排序,一切「查一下」的需求都走它,不用为每个场景单独接搜索。
blessonism-openclaw-search-skills-search.tagline_en: A default search layer for agents — multi-source concurrent retrieval with dedup and ranking, handling every "look this up" instead of wiring search per use case.
blessonism-openclaw-search-skills-search.why_zh: 搜索质量决定研究质量,单一搜索源的偏差会一路传导到结论;多源并发去重是研究型任务的地基件。
blessonism-openclaw-search-skills-search.why_en: Research quality rests on search quality — a single source's bias propagates all the way to the conclusion. Multi-source dedup is foundational.

liangdabiao-amazon-sorftime-research-mcp.tagline_zh: 亚马逊卖家的调研全家桶:竞品 Listing 全维度穿透、五维评分选品、2000+ 关键词八维分类、差评与市场动态分析,全部出 Markdown 报告。
liangdabiao-amazon-sorftime-research-mcp.tagline_en: A research kit for Amazon sellers — full-dimension competitor listing teardowns, five-factor category scoring, 2000+ keyword classification, review and market analysis, all as Markdown reports.
liangdabiao-amazon-sorftime-research-mcp.why_zh: 跨境电商的选品决策值真金白银,这套把「凭感觉选品」换成了有评分模型和关键词数据支撑的流程。
liangdabiao-amazon-sorftime-research-mcp.why_en: Product selection decides real money in cross-border e-commerce; this replaces gut feel with scoring models and keyword data.

hao0321-ai-short-drama.title_zh: 从零做一集 AI 短剧
hao0321-ai-short-drama.tagline_zh: 短剧是眼下最猛的内容形态，但一个人搞不定编剧+分镜+成片。它把这条流水线拆成能一步步走完的活。
hao0321-ai-short-drama.why_zh: 体量不大但路子对，适合先试水短剧的人；要成体系的还得看更完整的方案。
hao0321-ai-short-drama.limit_zh: 正文全繁体。它只产故事和 production pack，图片视频归未附带的 ai-media-generator；没装 video-autopilot 就只能标 waiting_for_executor，明令不许声称已出成片。
hao0321-ai-short-drama.limit_en: Traditional Chinese throughout. It owns story and the production pack only; media belongs to the separate ai-media-generator. Without video-autopilot it must mark the run `waiting_for_executor` and may not claim a finished cut.
hao0321-ai-short-drama.title_en: A short-drama writers' room with a QA pass

xlbaoxl-interactive-map-builder.title_zh: 把地点数据变成可交互的网页地图
xlbaoxl-interactive-map-builder.tagline_zh: 做旅行攻略、门店分布、活动路线，最后总卡在「怎么做一张能点的地图」。给它数据，它出一个能直接发的交互地图。
xlbaoxl-interactive-map-builder.why_zh: 输出是自包含网页而不是截图，能发能嵌；这类需求高频但少有现成解。
xlbaoxl-interactive-map-builder.limit_zh: 只接已有坐标或几何：地理编码、缓冲叠加、路径规划、3D 一概不做，缺 CRS 直接失败、不替你猜。要先 pip 装它的 Python 包，每次调用先联网跑一次版本 preflight，自动分类配色最多 8 类。
xlbaoxl-interactive-map-builder.limit_en: Takes existing coordinates or geometry only: no geocoding, buffers, routing or 3D, and a missing CRS fails hard instead of being guessed. You pip-install its Python package, every run opens with an online update preflight.
xlbaoxl-interactive-map-builder.title_en: A spreadsheet of coordinates, out as one HTML map

browser-act-skills.title_zh: 让 agent 自己开浏览器干活
browser-act-skills.tagline_zh: 很多事没有 API 只有网页：查后台、填表单、抓数据。装上它，agent 能自己打开浏览器点点点，还能穿过反爬墙。
browser-act-skills.why_zh: 它解决的是「agent 能想但手伸不出去」这个根本限制，属于能力型基建件，不是又一个工具。
browser-act-skills.limit_zh: 103 件的共同前提是先 uv tool install browser-act-cli（Python 3.12），skill 只是调用说明。绝大多数是按站点写死的抓取件，1688、Airbnb 这类页面一改就失效。CLI 自带 solve-captcha，会把验证码图上传。
browser-act-skills.limit_en: All 103 skills presuppose `uv tool install browser-act-cli` (Python 3.12); the skills are just call instructions. Most are site-specific scrapers (1688, Airbnb, TikTok…) that break when a page changes. The CLI ships a solve-captcha path that uploads the image.

xiaowu89-skill-matting.title_zh: 本地一键抠图，图片视频都能抠
xiaowu89-skill-matting.tagline_zh: 抠图工具要么要上传隐私图、要么按张收费。它用本地 BiRefNet 模型跑，输出透明底，素材不出你的机器。
xiaowu89-skill-matting.why_zh: 星不多但胜在纯本地：碰产品图、人像这类不该外传的素材时，比精度更值钱。
xiaowu89-skill-matting.limit_zh: 明写只支持 Windows x64 + PowerShell，Mac/Linux 跑不起来。首次联网从魔搭下 63.2MB 运行时和 88.6MB 模型（Full 约 440MB）。每次结果还必须原样贴出作者的加微信提示。
xiaowu89-skill-matting.limit_en: Frontmatter states Windows x64 + PowerShell only — Mac and Linux cannot run it. First use pulls a 63.2MB runtime plus an 88.6MB model from ModelScope (Full ~440MB). Every reply must reproduce the author's WeChat contact notice.
xiaowu89-skill-matting.title_en: Cuts out video backgrounds without a GPU

woowoeth-find-reusable.title_zh: 造轮子之前先查一遍有什么能复用
woowoeth-find-reusable.tagline_zh: 准备动手做一个东西时，最贵的浪费是别人早就做过了。说一句大白话「我想做 X」，它当场查库告诉你有没有、能用到什么程度。
woowoeth-find-reusable.tagline_en: The costliest waste is building what already exists. Say what you want to make in plain words and it tells you what's out there and how far you can reuse it.
woowoeth-find-reusable.why_zh: 本店自制，也是这家店真正想解决的问题。它标三档复用度（直接能用/要改一半/只能抄思路），查不到就直说没有——而所有查不到的需求会攒成缺口清单，那本身就是选题库。
woowoeth-find-reusable.why_en: Made in-house, and the reason this store exists. Three reuse verdicts, an honest "nobody built this" when there's no hit, and every miss accumulates into a gap list of what's worth building.
woowoeth-find-reusable.limit_zh: 查的是它自己那个库，不是 GitHub 或 npm 全网：库里没有只说明这家店没收，不等于没人做过。要能跑 python3 find_reusable.py，三档复用度也是照库里的文案判的，不是现场装一遍验证出来的。
woowoeth-find-reusable.limit_en: It searches its own catalog, not GitHub or npm at large — "not found" means this library lacks it, not that nobody built it. Needs python3 find_reusable.py locally, and the three reuse tiers are read off catalog copy, not from installing.
woowoeth-find-reusable.title_en: Finds what to reuse, or admits nobody built it

neallydare-svg-iching-divination.title_zh: 用密码学随机数起卦的周易占卜
neallydare-svg-iching-divination.tagline_zh: AI 算卦最没意思的是它会顺着你想听的编卦象。这个用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱，一事一占，凶卦如实直断，还能事后对账验证。
neallydare-svg-iching-divination.why_zh: 「绝不编造卦象」「凶卦如实直断」——它把占卜里最容易滑坡的那两处堵死了。认真对待玩的东西，本身就是一种品味。
neallydare-svg-iching-divination.limit_zh: 一事一占是硬规矩，你连问几件它会引蒙卦拒绝。也不答彩票号码、不替你做医疗和财务决定。
neallydare-svg-iching-divination.limit_en: One question per casting is enforced — ask several and it refuses, citing the Meng hexagram. It won't pick lottery numbers or make medical and financial decisions for you.
neallydare-svg-iching-divination.title_en: Divination by I Ching, with cryptographic dice
neallydare-svg-iching-divination.tagline_en: The dull thing about AI fortune-telling is that it quietly tells you what you want to hear. This one casts three coins with a cryptographic RNG, allows one question per casting, states bad hexagrams plainly, and invites you back to check whether it was right.
neallydare-svg-iching-divination.why_en: It seals the two places divination usually slides: no inventing hexagrams, no softening a bad one. Taking a game seriously is itself a kind of taste.

wolke-bazi-mingli.title_zh: 排八字四柱并给出命理分析
wolke-bazi-mingli.tagline_zh: 生辰八字最怕排盘错——一步错整盘废。它先把四柱排准，再谈解读，还能生成命盘图。
wolke-bazi-mingli.why_zh: 和店里的紫微排盘同一个作者，一个人把中文命理这块认真做全了：排盘用算法、解读才用模型。
wolke-bazi-mingli.limit_zh: 排盘是 scripts/bazi_calc.py 算的，解读仍由模型生成，没有本店周易那件的事后对账机制。正文全繁体，用语偏港台。
wolke-bazi-mingli.limit_en: The chart is computed by scripts/bazi_calc.py, but the reading is still model-generated, with none of the after-the-fact reconciliation the I Ching one has. Written entirely in traditional Chinese, Hong Kong/Taiwan usage.
wolke-bazi-mingli.title_en: A BaZi chart computed, then read
wolke-bazi-mingli.tagline_en: Chinese Four Pillars astrology falls apart if the chart itself is wrong — one slip and everything after it is noise. This computes the four pillars first, interprets second, and can render the chart as an image.
wolke-bazi-mingli.why_en: The chart comes from a script, the reading from the model. Keeping those two apart is the whole difference between a tool and a party trick.

kagurananaga-official-document-writing-s.title_zh: 按 GB/T 9704 规范写党政机关公文
kagurananaga-official-document-writing-s.tagline_zh: 请示、通知、函、纪要——体制内的公文错一个格式就要返工。它按国标给格式规范、模板和用语建议，还带质量检查。
kagurananaga-official-document-writing-s.why_zh: 极致垂直，而且是国外市场绝不会有的东西。作者引了具体国标号，说明他真的在这行里。
kagurananaga-official-document-writing-s.limit_zh: 它管 GB/T 9704 的格式与用语，不管这份文该不该发、内容对不对。全文没写任何适用边界，实质内容还是你自己扛。
kagurananaga-official-document-writing-s.limit_en: It covers GB/T 9704 formatting and register — not whether the document should be sent or whether its content is right. No stated boundaries anywhere in the skill.

panmax-hemingway-skill.title_zh: 用海明威的冰山理论帮你改写作
panmax-hemingway-skill.tagline_zh: 想让文字硬一点、少一点形容词，却说不清怎么改。它用冰山理论、极简短句和硬汉式克制来回应——只谈写作，不扮演海明威本人。
panmax-hemingway-skill.why_zh: 「不要用来扮演本人」这条边界划得清醒：它做的是方法迁移，不是角色扮演。这个分寸是品味。
panmax-hemingway-skill.limit_zh: 作者明说不因一般问题自动触发，得你点名叫它。而且只对写作和表达类问题有用，拿它聊别的等于没装。
panmax-hemingway-skill.limit_en: The author explicitly disables auto-triggering — you have to call it by name. It only helps with writing and expression; for anything else it may as well not be installed.
panmax-hemingway-skill.title_en: Iceberg theory applied to your draft
panmax-hemingway-skill.tagline_en: You want the prose harder and the adjectives gone but can't say how. It answers through iceberg theory, short declaratives and hard-boiled restraint — and it discusses writing only; it does not play Hemingway.
panmax-hemingway-skill.why_en: 'Do not use this to impersonate the man' is a clear-eyed boundary: it transfers a method, it doesn't cosplay an author. That sense of proportion is taste.

yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.title_zh: 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 海报
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.tagline_zh: 不调任何图像生成模型——用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。给它一张你自己拍的照片，出一张极简版画感的纸质海报。
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.why_zh: 「不用生图模型」是个很硬的自我约束，也正是它出品统一的原因：所有效果都来自可控的代码，而不是抽卡。
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.limit_zh: 要本机跑得起无头 Chrome 和 Python PIL；缺一样它就降级——交你一个 HTML 自己开、颜色请你自己报。手机上基本用不了。
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.limit_en: Needs headless Chrome and Python PIL locally. Missing either, it degrades — hands you the raw HTML and asks you to name the colors. Unusable on a phone.
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.cover_note: 作者 examples/ 里的成品海报（-poster），不是 -original 输入原片。抓取误取输入，2026-08-19 人工更正。
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.title_en: A photo distilled into a minimal zine poster
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.tagline_en: No image model anywhere in the pipeline — it draws with hand-written HTML/CSS/SVG and exports a PNG through headless Chrome. Give it a photo you took; you get a print-feeling minimal poster.
yangcodingmaster-photo-distill.why_en: Refusing to generate is a hard constraint, and it's exactly why the output is consistent: every effect comes from code you can control, not from rerolling.

ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.title_zh: 查北京 16 区花粉浓度和过敏预报
ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.tagline_zh: 每年三四月对花粉过敏的人来说是渡劫。它拉 16 个站点的实时监测和分类预报，按区查，出门前知道今天该不该戴口罩。
ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.why_zh: 垂直到一个城市、一种过敏原——但对那批人是刚需。这种「窄得理直气壮」正是大市场覆盖不到的东西。
ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.limit_zh: metadata 里明写要本机有 curl 和 jq，全靠 scripts/beijing-pollen-query.sh 打公开接口。范围钉死北京 16 区，作者写明北京以外不要用。而且它只查不推——「每天早上发我」那种晨报要调用方自己接。
ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.limit_en: Its metadata requires curl and jq locally and everything runs through one shell script against a public endpoint. Pinned to Beijing's 16 districts; the author says plainly not to use it elsewhere. It queries on demand and does not push.
ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.title_en: Pollen by district, for one city that needs it
ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.tagline_en: March and April are an ordeal if you're allergic. It pulls live readings and graded forecasts from 16 monitoring stations, queryable by district, so you know before you leave whether to mask up.
ruochenlyu-beijing-pollen-monitor.why_en: Narrow to one city and one allergen — and for those people it's essential. That kind of unembarrassed narrowness is exactly what a large marketplace never covers.

zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.title_zh: 把旅行计划做成手机上能离线看的网页
zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.tagline_zh: 到了当地没网、翻聊天记录找攻略最抓狂。它出单文件 HTML：交互地图 + 每日时间轴 + 出发前订票提醒，存手机上离线可读。
zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.why_zh: 「离线可读、手机优先、单文件」——这三个约束是真在国外用过才想得到的，不是坐在电脑前设计出来的。
zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.limit_zh: 地图引的是 Leaflet CDN，所谓「离线可读」保得住文字和时间轴，地图那块断网就是空的。实时票价、代订票、多语言、后端，作者在「不做」一节里明写一概不做。最后那步校验要本机有 node 跑 assets/validate.js。
zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.limit_en: The map is a Leaflet CDN embed, so 'offline' holds for the text and timeline but the map goes blank. Live fares, booking, multi-language and any backend are listed under what it deliberately does not do.
zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.title_en: A trip plan you can still read with no signal
zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.tagline_en: The worst moment abroad is standing on a corner with no data, scrolling chat history for the plan. It emits one HTML file: interactive map, day-by-day timeline, pre-departure booking reminders — saved to your phone, readable offline.
zexuanw958-svg-travel-plan-viz.why_en: Offline-readable, phone-first, single file. Those three constraints only occur to someone who has actually needed them abroad.

lijigang-ljg-skills.title_zh: 把一个观点写成经得住反例的文章
lijigang-ljg-skills.tagline_zh: AI 写观点文最容易变成正确的废话。它的目标很具体：1000-1500 字，可理解、可迁移、经得住反例——而且明说不做普通摘要。
lijigang-ljg-skills.why_zh: 「经得住反例」是我见过对写作最狠的自我要求，比「高质量」这类词实在得多。作者知道自己在做什么。
lijigang-ljg-skills.limit_zh: 产出直接落成 Org 文件写进 ~/Documents/notes，文件头的 author 写死「李继刚」，保存后还要过 org-lint 和 Denote 校验——不用 Emacs/Org 的人得先拆掉这一整套。默认 1000–1500 字，摘要和事实查询作者明写不接。
lijigang-ljg-skills.limit_en: Output lands as Org files in ~/Documents/notes with the author field hard-coded, then runs org-lint and Denote checks. If you don't use Emacs and Org, you're dismantling that whole stack first.
lijigang-ljg-skills.title_en: An argument built to survive counterexamples
lijigang-ljg-skills.tagline_en: AI opinion pieces default to being correct and empty. This one sets a specific bar: 1000–1500 words, understandable, transferable, and able to survive counterexamples — and it explicitly refuses to write summaries.
lijigang-ljg-skills.why_en: 'Survives counterexamples' is the most demanding thing I've seen a writing skill ask of itself. Far more concrete than claiming 'high quality'.

chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.title_zh: 把长期健身做成有剧情的 RPG
chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.tagline_zh: 健身最难的是坚持，不是动作。它用本地文件记录你的训练、疲劳和复训，再让训练结果推进剧情——练得好剧情才往前走。
chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.why_zh: 把「坚持」这个真问题用游戏机制解决，而不是再给一份训练计划表。全本地存档，数据不外传。
chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.limit_zh: 数据全存本地 user-data/，换台机器就从零开始。没有 Python 环境时改由模型手写 JSON，脚本那层的单位和日期校验就失效了。
chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.limit_en: All data lives in a local user-data/ folder; switch machines and you start over. Without Python it falls back to the model hand-writing JSON, losing the script's unit and date checks.
chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.title_en: Long-term training as a story you unlock
chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.tagline_en: Sticking with it is the hard part, not the movements. It keeps your sessions, fatigue and returns in local files, then lets the results move a storyline forward — train well and the plot advances.
chenklein26-maker-fitness-coach-rpg.why_en: It answers the real problem — consistency — with a game mechanic instead of yet another training plan. Everything stays on your machine.

joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.title_zh: 给应届生从零做一份可投递的简历
joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.tagline_zh: 学生最大的问题是「没什么可写的」。它用一问一答访谈从零挖经历，再建立岗位要求与你经历的证据映射，不许编造。
joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.why_zh: 乔木出品。「要求—证据映射」这个设计防的正是简历造假式优化——挖你真有的，而不是替你编。
joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.limit_zh: 全程靠 Python 脚本串起来：extract、assess、validate、render 一个都少不了。中文 PDF 要本机真装了主题字体，Kami 认 TsangerJinKai02。学术 CV、高管履历、求职信都不做。
joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.limit_en: The whole flow runs through Python scripts — extract, assess, validate, render — none optional. Chinese PDF output needs the theme font actually installed locally. Academic CVs, executive résumés and cover letters are out of scope.
joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.title_en: A first résumé built from an interview, not invented
joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.tagline_en: The student's real problem is having nothing to put down. It interviews you from zero to surface what you've actually done, then maps job requirements to evidence you can point at — and refuses to fabricate.
joeseesun-qiaomu-campus-resume.why_en: The requirement-to-evidence mapping is aimed squarely at résumé inflation: it digs out what you have rather than writing what you don't.

redfox-data-redfox-community.title_zh: 分析某位作者的多篇文章复刻其文风
redfox-data-redfox-community.tagline_zh: 想学某个人的写法，读十篇也说不清他到底怎么写的。它拆解一位作者的多篇文章还原其思维方式，生成专属写作分身和风格提示词。
redfox-data-redfox-community.why_zh: 「还原思维方式」比「模仿句式」高一档——前者能迁移到新题材，后者换个题目就露馅。
redfox-data-redfox-community.limit_zh: 要去作者自家 redfox.hk 注册拿 REDFOX_API_KEY 配成环境变量才跑得动，平台采集只覆盖公众号和抖音。素材少于 3 篇 2000 字别指望还原，理想量作者标的是 10 篇 1 万字。核心流程在 references/core_workflow.md。
redfox-data-redfox-community.limit_en: Needs a REDFOX_API_KEY from the author's own redfox.hk, and its collection covers only WeChat and Douyin. Under three pieces or 2000 words there's nothing to reconstruct; the author's stated target is ten pieces, 10k words.
redfox-data-redfox-community.title_en: Reverse-engineer a writer's voice from their work
redfox-data-redfox-community.tagline_en: Reading ten pieces still won't tell you how someone actually writes. This takes a body of one author's work apart, reconstructs how they think, and gives you a writing persona plus style prompts.
redfox-data-redfox-community.why_en: Reconstructing the thinking beats mimicking the sentences — the first transfers to new subjects, the second falls apart the moment the topic changes.

jangviktor-web-nihaixia.title_zh: 会标出哪句没根据的倪海厦中医
jangviktor-web-nihaixia.tagline_zh: 市面上倪师的东西多是剪辑和二传，真假掺着卖。它蒸馏的是一手素材——梁冬对话录音稿、人纪班闭门课记录、神农本草经视频讲义。
jangviktor-web-nihaixia.title_en: A TCM lineage that flags its own unverified claims
jangviktor-web-nihaixia.tagline_en: Most Ni Hai-Sha material online is clipped and re-transmitted, truth and hearsay mixed together. This distils primary sources: recorded dialogue transcripts, closed-door class notes, lecture material on the Shennong herbal classic.
jangviktor-web-nihaixia.why_en: It splits 'verified' from 'commonly repeated' into its own section. A skill built on lineage that will name its own weak claims is rarer than one with more knowledge.
jangviktor-web-nihaixia.limit_en: Large as it is, it's a knowledge base: reasoning is for study, not prescription, and dosage must come from a licensed practitioner in person — tongue and pulse cannot be read from text. Chinese only, and it argues from one school, not all of TCM.

jangviktor-web-likeskill.title_zh: 认出 24 种假证，别把寒极当热治
jangviktor-web-likeskill.tagline_zh: 中医最容易翻车的不是不会开方，是看反了：寒极似热、虚极似实，一反就用反药。它从 423 个医案里整出 24 种假证的识别法。
jangviktor-web-likeskill.title_en: Twenty-four ways a cold case looks hot
jangviktor-web-likeskill.tagline_en: The dangerous mistake in Chinese medicine isn't a weak formula — it's reading the pattern backwards: extreme cold presenting as heat, depletion presenting as excess. Treat that backwards and you make it worse. This distils 24 such false presentations from 423 case records.
jangviktor-web-likeskill.why_en: Most 'master' compilations copy the formulas. This one copies the places judgment went wrong — and sets a hard low-start dose ceiling for elderly patients, because aconite is toxic and someone cared enough to write that down.
jangviktor-web-likeskill.limit_en: Built around high-dose classical formulas; the author states plainly they require an experienced practitioner's supervision and that this is for study only. The emergency formulas in particular must not be copied — an aconite dosing error can kill.

yuanzhao321-tcm-skill.title_zh: 会劝你去挂急诊的中医参谋
yuanzhao321-tcm-skill.tagline_zh: 家里人不舒服，最难的是判断「要不要现在就去医院」。它把疑似致命的情况列成红线层——高热神昏、胸痛彻背、假神脱汗，一律叫急救不辨证。
yuanzhao321-tcm-skill.title_en: Traditional medicine that tells you to call an ambulance
yuanzhao321-tcm-skill.tagline_en: The hard call at home is not which remedy — it's whether to go to hospital now. It puts suspected life-threatening presentations in a red-line tier: high fever with confusion, chest pain through to the back, cold sweat — call emergency services, no differentiation.
yuanzhao321-tcm-skill.why_en: The safest boundary I've seen in this category. It names the failure mode where a traditional framework delays real care, and refuses to be used there.
yuanzhao321-tcm-skill.limit_en: Positioned as a family adviser, not a physician; it writes no prescriptions. Self-administered acupuncture is forbidden outright, explanation only. It argues from the textbook tradition and will not reconcile itself with rival schools. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to tcm.
yuanzhao321-tcm-skill.limit_zh: 定位是「家庭参谋而非医师」，不出处方。针刺绝对禁止自行操作，只解释指路。教材派立场，与经方派、温病派的结论会不一致，它不替你调和。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文「中医」，装上后可能不被识别，改成 tcm 更稳。

jangviktor-web-wujutong.title_zh: 古人自相矛盾处不替你抹平的温病医
jangviktor-web-wujutong.tagline_zh: 温病和伤寒是两套打法，用错了会反着治。它按《温病条辨》三焦辨证走，22 首方按上中下焦排开，359 个医案双索引。
jangviktor-web-wujutong.title_en: A school that leaves the contradictions standing
jangviktor-web-wujutong.tagline_en: Warm-disease theory and cold-damage theory are two different games; use the wrong one and you treat backwards. This follows the triple-burner differentiation, 22 core formulas laid out by burner, 359 case records double-indexed.
jangviktor-web-wujutong.why_en: One section is titled 'internal tensions — kept, not reconciled'. Where the classical author contradicts himself, it leaves the seam visible. It also names the rival school by skill and sends you there.
jangviktor-web-wujutong.limit_en: Warm disease only — cold damage, miscellaneous disease and the qi-dynamic school are out of scope and the author points each one elsewhere. No prescriptions; safety notice in its own section.

voidforall-fengshui-skill.title_zh: 先说自己不算命的风水顾问
voidforall-fengshui-skill.tagline_zh: 看房时想问朝向旺位煞气，网上说法互相打架。它按三元玄空飞星、八宅明镜、形势峦头三套体系分开算，不合并成一个答案糊弄你。
voidforall-fengshui-skill.title_en: A feng shui adviser that opens by limiting itself
voidforall-fengshui-skill.tagline_en: You want to ask about orientation, favourable sectors and sha positions, and every source online contradicts the last. This runs three systems separately — Flying Star, Eight Mansions, and form-and-landform — instead of blending them into one confident answer.
voidforall-fengshui-skill.why_en: Its honesty section quotes the classics to say feng shui assists but does not determine fate. A practice that shrinks its own claim first is easier to trust.
voidforall-fengshui-skill.limit_en: The three systems routinely disagree with each other; it shows them side by side and won't adjudicate for you. Burial-site practice varies enormously by region — don't read it as a general rule.

seiya89757-naming-skill.title_zh: 全家为起名吵架时出来当中间人
seiya89757-naming-skill.tagline_zh: 起名难的从来不是想不出字，是爷爷要字辈、妈妈嫌笔画多、爸爸信五行。它专门做了协商模式，把冲突摆到台面上一条条谈。
seiya89757-naming-skill.title_en: Mediating the family argument about the baby's name
seiya89757-naming-skill.tagline_en: Naming a Chinese child is never short of characters — it's short of agreement: grandfather wants the generation character, mother says too many strokes, father wants the five elements balanced. It has a negotiation mode that puts the conflict on the table.
seiya89757-naming-skill.why_en: The anti-patterns section is unusually clear-eyed: never fake a birth chart when no birth time was given, never reach for a rare character to balance the elements — 'the child will write it and hear it mispronounced for a lifetime'.
seiya89757-naming-skill.limit_en: It refuses shops, brands, pets, game characters and fictional names, and won't do pure fortune-telling or interpret an existing name. Dialect checks cover only the language groups it knows; where it doesn't know, it says so.

mrchendev-cantonese-lyrics.title_zh: 逐字查九声六调，填不倒字的粤语词
mrchendev-cantonese-lyrics.tagline_zh: 粤语填词的门槛不是押韵，是「倒字」——字调和旋律拧了，唱出来就成了另一个词。它把协音检查做进流程，还带黄霑林夕的手法档案。
mrchendev-cantonese-lyrics.title_en: Cantonese lyrics checked tone by tone
mrchendev-cantonese-lyrics.tagline_en: The barrier in Cantonese lyric writing isn't rhyme, it's 'wrong tone' — when the pitch of a word fights the melody, it comes out as a different word entirely. This builds the tone-melody check into the process, with style profiles from the great Hong Kong lyricists.
mrchendev-cantonese-lyrics.why_en: The style profiles are stated to be generalisations drawn from published lyrics and interviews, not the writers' intent. Transferring a method rather than borrowing a name — that's the proportion I look for.
mrchendev-cantonese-lyrics.limit_en: The tone check is heuristic — roughly matching pitch contour to melodic direction — and the ear decides in the end. Tone marking depends on a Jyutping library; rare and multi-reading characters need a human pass.

xxxonechen-pollen-query.title_zh: 花粉季出门前查一眼，53 城都有
xxxonechen-pollen-query.tagline_zh: 三四月对过敏的人是渡劫，而多数天气 app 根本不报花粉。它拉中国天气网的监测站数据，给浓度等级、风险提示和 7 天历史加预报。
xxxonechen-pollen-query.title_en: Check pollen before you go out, 53 cities
xxxonechen-pollen-query.tagline_en: Allergy season is an ordeal and most weather apps don't report pollen at all. It pulls monitoring-station data for grade, risk note, and seven days of history plus forecast.
xxxonechen-pollen-query.why_en: Standard library only, nothing to install; the fallback source is kept clearly separate from the primary one, and when data is missing it says so rather than passing off a dispersal index as a concentration.
xxxonechen-pollen-query.limit_en: Only the 53 cities with monitoring stations; smaller cities have no data. Out of season it reports none, and gaps on individual days are normal. The fallback gives a dispersal index, not a concentration — don't read them as the same number. Mainland China only.

sunnypanzhen-fishing-skill.title_zh: 新手买竿，老手看天：从选位讲起
sunnypanzhen-fishing-skill.tagline_zh: 没口的时候多半不是饵不对，是位置和天气不对。它把选位排在全篇第一，气压风向温差降雨讲完才轮到装备，台钓路亚海钓黑坑都覆盖。
sunnypanzhen-fishing-skill.title_en: Beginners buy rods, veterans read the weather
sunnypanzhen-fishing-skill.tagline_en: When nothing bites it's usually not the bait — it's the spot and the conditions. Swim selection comes first in the whole document; pressure, wind, temperature swing and rain are covered before any tackle, across float, lure, sea and commercial fisheries.
sunnypanzhen-fishing-skill.why_en: The table of contents is the argument: 'swim selection (most important, first)'. It leads with what actually separates a veteran from a beginner instead of opening with gear recommendations.
sunnypanzhen-fishing-skill.limit_en: Experience-based knowledge with no live water or weather feed, so you still map it onto the day yourself. Weighted towards Chinese freshwater methods; the sea-fishing material is thinner.

alaric1098-china-pension-strategy-skill.title_zh: 社保断缴要不要补，用脚本算给你看
alaric1098-china-pension-strategy-skill.tagline_zh: 权益单看不懂、断缴要不要补、灵活就业还交不交——这些是算术题不是玄学，但谁也不愿替你算。它按地区规则出确定值。
alaric1098-china-pension-strategy-skill.title_en: Whether to back-pay your pension gap, computed
alaric1098-china-pension-strategy-skill.tagline_en: Nobody wants to work out whether a contribution gap is worth filling, or whether flexible-employment contributions still pay off. These are arithmetic problems, not mysteries. It runs them against regional rules.
alaric1098-china-pension-strategy-skill.why_en: Every policy figure goes through a deterministic CLI and it says outright that it never computes them inline. Models get social-insurance arithmetic wrong; this closes that door.
alaric1098-china-pension-strategy-skill.limit_en: Privacy model is ALLOW / REDACT / BLOCK — national ID, social-security and bank card numbers are blocked outright. Still a local MVP with limited regional coverage, and results follow the current policy basis. Mainland China only.

mixiaxiaoyu-scraply.title_zh: 照片排成带票据和胶带的手账跨页
mixiaxiaoyu-scraply.tagline_zh: 旅行照片攒了一堆，做手账要排半天版。它出的不是九宫格拼图，是带纸张质感、贴纸、票根、胶带和手写标题的成品跨页。
mixiaxiaoyu-scraply.title_en: Photos laid out as a paper journal spread
mixiaxiaoyu-scraply.tagline_en: You come back with a pile of travel photos and spend an evening arranging them. What this returns isn't a grid collage — it's a finished spread with paper texture, stickers, ticket stubs, tape and a handwritten title.
mixiaxiaoyu-scraply.why_en: The default is one stable classic layout; you have to explicitly ask for the random mode. Stable by default, varied on request — that order is the right way round.
mixiaxiaoyu-scraply.limit_en: You get a finished image, not an editable file, so changing the layout means regenerating. The default look is locked to blue cutting mat and white-bordered prints; if that isn't your taste there's little to adjust.

shuangying0001-beep-canvas-grid-engine.title_zh: 一句话打印一张米字格字帖
shuangying0001-beep-canvas-grid-engine.tagline_zh: 给孩子练字或补语文作业，找一张合规的练习纸比想象中难。13 种格任选，汉字自动居中、带拼音标注，A4 直出。
shuangying0001-beep-canvas-grid-engine.tagline_en: Getting a properly ruled practice sheet for a child's handwriting turns out to be harder than it should be. Thirteen grid types, characters auto-centred, optional pinyin annotation, straight to A4.
shuangying0001-beep-canvas-grid-engine.why_en: It only draws; export and replication are left to two sibling skills. Drawing the line that clearly is rarer than being a toolbox that half-does everything.
shuangying0001-beep-canvas-grid-engine.limit_en: It's a rendering engine, not a finished app — it needs a 2D canvas context, and the Node self-test only checks the maths. Missing fonts silently fall back to system serif, so swap in your own before shipping. Upstream's name field contains a slash and parentheses, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to canvas-grid-engine.
shuangying0001-beep-canvas-grid-engine.limit_zh: 是个渲染引擎不是成品应用，需要 2D canvas 上下文才能画，Node 里自测只验数学不出图。字体缺失会静默回退系统 serif，正式用要自己换字体。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 带斜杠和括号，装上后可能不被识别，改成 canvas-grid-engine 更稳。

sumanasj-coc-kp-host.title_zh: 写到第三段就把回合交回来的克苏鲁跑团 KP
sumanasj-coc-kp-host.tagline_zh: AI 当 KP 最烦的是一口气把三个场景演完。它给自己设了硬上限：一回合一拍、2–4 句，停在你能动手的那一刻。
sumanasj-coc-kp-host.why_zh: 队友 NPC 是 AI 扮的调查员不是提示频道：不许总结主线、不许给路线排正确度，要拿信息也得掷骰。
sumanasj-coc-kp-host.limit_zh: 模组正文得你自己有——它明写有原文时不许凭记忆讲，没有原文就只能即兴。配乐是在浏览器里开一个搜索结果页，作者承认查不到具体曲目时就让你自己按播放。它还会照模组把 1920 年代的种族歧视当成线索门禁执行，只在开局前问你能接受到什么程度。
sumanasj-coc-kp-host.title_en: Hands the turn back the moment it starts a third paragraph
sumanasj-coc-kp-host.tagline_en: The worst thing an AI Keeper does is play three scenes in one breath. This caps itself hard: one beat per turn, two to four sentences, stopping where you can act.
sumanasj-coc-kp-host.why_en: Companion NPCs are run as AI-played investigators, not hint channels: they may not summarise the plot or rank routes by correctness, and must roll like anyone else to learn things.
sumanasj-coc-kp-host.limit_en: You have to supply the scenario text yourself — the file forbids narrating from memory when canon exists, and without it the Keeper is improvising. Music opens a search-results page in your browser, and the author admits it tells you to hit play when a specific track cannot be verified. It will also enforce 1920s racism as a clue gate when the module calls for it, checking your comfort level only once before play.

wangchangwei-arb-skill.title_en: Build the evidence file after you're fired
wangchangwei-arb-skill.tagline_en: Labour arbitration is hard at both ends: the evidence is scattered across attendance logs and chat history, and you have no idea what number to ask for. This parses attendance files, computes overtime, severance and social-insurance shortfalls, and writes it up.
wangchangwei-arb-skill.why_en: It is unambiguously on the employee's side — not an HR compliance tool, an evidence tool for the person who was let go. Knowing whose side you're on is itself taste.
wangchangwei-arb-skill.limit_en: Calculations use general formulas; local arbitration commissions differ a great deal in practice, so the report is a negotiating draft, not a conclusion. Mainland China labour law only.

bh-m87-futu-statement-skill.title_en: Find the numbers a broker statement hides
bh-m87-futu-statement-skill.tagline_en: Reporting overseas investment income stalls on the broker statement: dividends and realised P&L are not in the column you'd expect, and the statement doesn't compute the figure you need at all.
bh-m87-futu-statement-skill.why_en: The whole document is about where the numbers actually live and how to rebuild what the statement omits, with a section of common traps. That only comes from grinding through real statements.
bh-m87-futu-statement-skill.limit_en: Reads official statement files only; it never connects to your account. Futu's format specifically — other brokers won't parse. The reconstructed P&L follows its own convention; check it before filing.

tong666-bit-liu-xiaoyan-skill.title_en: Exam coaching that refuses to sound like a textbook
tong666-bit-liu-xiaoyan-skill.tagline_en: The worst thing about test prep is a lesson so even-toned you remember none of it. This models a well-known Chinese exam coach's blunt classroom voice — peeling long sentences apart, assembling essays from patterns — calibrated against the June 2026 CET-6 paper.
tong666-bit-liu-xiaoyan-skill.why_en: Its 'absolutely forbidden' section is written in reverse: no academic register, no translationese, no 'firstly, secondly, finally'. Using rules to make a lesson sound human is harder than piling on content.
tong666-bit-liu-xiaoyan-skill.limit_en: A simulation of a teaching style, not the person; the method is drawn from public course material. It makes no predictions about what will be on the paper, and calibration stops at June 2026. Chinese English-exam context (CET/postgraduate).

xntj-ai-baoxiao.title_en: Loose receipts into a filed expense claim
xntj-ai-baoxiao.tagline_en: The annoying part of expenses isn't the form, it's that the receipts are scattered across chat, email and photos — and you have to avoid claiming one twice. It renames and files them to a convention first, then produces a cover summary plus per-receipt detail PDF.
xntj-ai-baoxiao.why_en: It ships a duplicate-check ledger as a CSV. That isn't a feature a product person invents; it's one someone adds after finance has bounced their claim.
xntj-ai-baoxiao.limit_en: Handles Chinese VAT e-invoice PDFs and photos of paper receipts; photos go through vision and blurry or glared ones misread, so the verification step is required, not optional. Mainland China invoicing conventions.

zzzzzzza-larp-skill.title_en: Keep talking to a murder-mystery character after the game
zzzzzzza-larp-skill.tagline_en: The character disappears when the session ends, but you might still want to talk to them. Feed it the player script and character bio as PDF; it extracts story memory and personality into a character you can keep talking to.
zzzzzzza-larp-skill.why_en: Its safety section refuses to leak the core trick or the culprit, and won't reveal what the character shouldn't know. A roleplay tool that guards against spoilers on its own is written by someone who actually plays.
zzzzzzza-larp-skill.limit_en: For personal enjoyment only — not for helping someone else through a game they haven't played. Output quality follows the source: a thin bio yields a thin character. Needs file read/write permission.

weante-city-salary.title_en: Take-home pay by the rules of your actual city
weante-city-salary.tagline_en: A single national salary calculator is always wrong — contribution bases, rates and tiers are set city by city. This carries real parameters for 21 cities in Guangdong and can render an interactive calculator.
weante-city-salary.why_en: The grain is what makes it usable: local household registration forcing a specific medical tier, one city offering three, another splitting pooled from individual accounts. You only write that after reading the local documents.
weante-city-salary.limit_en: Only 21 Guangdong cities are built in; anywhere else you extend the structure yourself. Parameters are on the 2025–2026 basis and contribution bases reset annually — run its freshness check first. Mainland China only.

chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.title_zh: 替猫拦下云南白药和藿香正气的养猫参谋
chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.tagline_zh: 猫吐了、乱尿了、咬人了，中文经验帖和「打一下就记住」全是坑；它先过一遍急诊红旗再答，答案对齐国际猫科福利指南。
chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.why_zh: 它把「不给剂量」做成硬规则：连人用药折算、朋友说、写科普这几种绕法都点名堵死。
chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.limit_zh: 正文明写不给任何药物剂量、频次、疗程，即便用户声称兽医已给过指示也不替他补全。点名拒绝云南白药、藿香正气、蒙脱石散这类家庭偏方。只管猫不管狗；无法联网时不给召回、地区疫苗规则等当前结论，只讲原则和该去核验的官方渠道。
chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.title_en: The cat advisor that will not hand you a dose
chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.tagline_en: Vomiting, litter-box protests, biting — the folk remedies circulating online make it worse. This runs an emergency red-flag pass first, then answers from AAFP/ISFM welfare guidance.
chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.why_en: The refusal is hard-coded: no doses, and it names the loopholes it will not accept — "my vet already told me", "it's just for an article", "convert it by weight".
chongchonghaoman-feline-health-advisory.limit_en: The file bars every drug dose, frequency and course, and will not fill gaps even when the user says a vet gave instructions. It names Yunnan Baiyao, Huoxiang Zhengqi and smectite as home remedies it refuses. Cats only. Offline, it gives principles and the official channels to check rather than current recall or regional vaccine rules.

r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.title_zh: 查稀有鸟最近落在哪，顺带说清中文名是台湾译名
r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.tagline_zh: 想知道这周末附近有没有稀有鸟、哪个热点在出货，它直连康奈尔 eBird 官方接口取真实观察记录，不靠模型记忆瞎编。
r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.why_zh: 20 个端点逐个实测过，还写明哪两个已经 404/403、别调；观测数据一律来自接口，不许凭训练知识补。
r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.limit_zh: 要自己去 ebird.org/api/keygen 申请免费 key，该 key 限非商业用途、并发超过 3 就 429。recent 端点最多回溯 30 天，全量历史得另申请 EBD。locale=zh 返回繁体台湾名（如「鉛色水鶇」），大陆常用名作者明说要自己维护别名表。
r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.title_en: Ask eBird who saw what bird, and where, this week
r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.tagline_en: Wondering whether anything rare has turned up near you this weekend, or which hotspot is producing — this queries Cornell's eBird API v2 directly for real sightings.
r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.why_en: All twenty endpoints were tested by hand, including the two that return 404 and 403 and are marked do-not-call. Sightings must come from the API, never from the model's memory.
r0ses1r-dev-birdsight.limit_en: You supply your own free key from ebird.org/api/keygen; free keys are non-commercial and start returning 429 above three concurrent requests. Recent-observation endpoints look back thirty days at most — full history needs a separate EBD request. Chinese common names come back in Taiwanese traditional form, and the author says to keep your own alias table rather than invent mainland ones.

wei011-heat-risk-calc.title_zh: 用湿球温度算出 48℃ 的吐鲁番比长沙安全
wei011-heat-risk-calc.tagline_zh: 「今天能不能跑步、军训、开工」，看气温会看错。它拉 open-meteo 七天预报算湿球温度，按五级直接给行动建议。
wei011-heat-risk-calc.why_zh: 换掉了大家惯用的那把尺子：31℃ 湿球以上一切户外都危险，35℃ 是理论生存极限（PNAS 2010）。
wei011-heat-risk-calc.limit_zh: 只给风险等级和建议，不做诊断——正文最后一条是出现高热无汗、意识模糊立即就医。中文城市名查不到时要改传拼音（作者举的例子是 Dunhuang）。数据源单一，只有 open-meteo 的 7 天预报，没有实测站点校正。
wei011-heat-risk-calc.title_en: Wet-bulb math that puts 48°C in Turpan below 35°C in Changsha
wei011-heat-risk-calc.tagline_en: Deciding whether it is safe to run, drill or work outside today — air temperature will mislead you. This pulls a seven-day open-meteo forecast, computes wet-bulb, and grades five risk levels.
wei011-heat-risk-calc.why_en: It swaps out the scale people actually use: above 31°C wet-bulb all outdoor activity is dangerous, and 35°C is the theoretical survival limit, cited to Sherwood & Huber, PNAS 2010.
wei011-heat-risk-calc.limit_en: It grades risk and stops there — the file's closing line sends anyone with high fever without sweating, or confusion, straight to a hospital. Chinese city names that miss have to be retyped in pinyin (the worked example is Dunhuang). One data source only: the open-meteo seven-day forecast, with no station correction.

fxw-labs-beachcombing.title_zh: 把你必须几点前撤离滩涂顶在报告最前面的赶海参谋
fxw-labs-beachcombing.tagline_zh: 大潮那两小时能挖到什么、几点回头才不会被围住——它先算撤退时刻再谈收获，11 省 51 处点位带方言别名和吃法。
fxw-labs-beachcombing.why_zh: 最难得的是它给自己设了上限：走天文骨架估算时，适用性评分强制压到五档里的第二档，不假装精确。
fxw-labs-beachcombing.limit_zh: 只覆盖中国大陆沿海，内置点库 11 省 51 处，其余靠 geocoding 兜底。没接真实潮汐 API 时走农历半日潮天文骨架，正文标「估算 ±1h」且评分不超过五档中的第二档。明确不做钓鱼预报、不做生物图像识别、不做休渔期与保护区的法律核对。
fxw-labs-beachcombing.title_en: The tide guide that leads with when you must be off the flats
fxw-labs-beachcombing.tagline_en: What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.
fxw-labs-beachcombing.why_en: The rare part is the ceiling it puts on itself: when it falls back to an astronomical skeleton estimate, the suitability rating is capped at the second of five levels rather than faked.
fxw-labs-beachcombing.limit_en: Mainland Chinese coast only — 51 built-in sites across 11 provinces, everything else falls back to geocoding. Without a real tide API it computes a lunar semidiurnal skeleton, labelled "estimated ±1h" and capped at the second of five suitability levels. It explicitly declines fishing forecasts, species photo ID, and any legal check on closed seasons or protected areas.

yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.title_zh: 专防「假托崔玉涛」文章的 0–13 岁育儿参谋
yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.tagline_zh: 孩子发烧、咬人、不肯吃饭时，最怕搜到一篇署名权威的假文章。它逼自己每个结论凑够两个独立来源，凑不够就明说降可信度。
yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.why_zh: 它给自己列了一张「AI 可能说的借口」对照表——「症状太典型了基本能确定」在表里是必须叫停的信号。
yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.limit_zh: 档案默认写进 Obsidian 式知识库的固定路径（08-全局记忆/L1-画像记忆/孩子名），没有知识库得先指定一个本地目录。覆盖 0–13 岁，只说「症状被关联到 XX」不说「得了 XX」，不推荐任何药品和剂量；输入命中呼吸困难、抽搐等词会跳过全部流程，只输出就医引导。
yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.title_en: A 0–13 parenting advisor that will not take one source's word for it
yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.tagline_en: Fever, biting, refusing food — the real hazard is landing on a convincing article falsely bylined to a famous pediatrician. This forces two independent authoritative sources per conclusion, or downgrades its own confidence out loud.
yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.why_en: It keeps a table of the excuses an AI is likely to make. "The symptoms are textbook, I can basically confirm it" is listed there as a signal to stop, not to proceed.
yeyulangzi-parenting-advisor.limit_en: Profiles are written to a fixed Obsidian-style vault path, so without a vault you must nominate a local directory first. Ages 0–13. It says "this symptom has been associated with X", never "your child has X", and recommends no drug or dose. Words like breathing difficulty or seizure skip every workflow and return only a go-to-hospital message.

violasi-reading-diary.title_zh: 把分级读物 PDF 里嵌的真人音频一页页抠出来
violasi-reading-diary.tagline_zh: 孩子要读的分级读物是一堆 PDF，音频嵌在里面拿不出来。它按页抠图抠音、校对页码和音轨错位，一天打一个包传平板。
violasi-reading-diary.why_zh: 它反过来劝你别加功能：纯图绘本不硬配音也不补文本，理由是亲子阅读本来就是大人念给孩子听。
violasi-reading-diary.limit_zh: 产出的 .rdpkg 只有同仓库那个网页 App 能打开，家长端要能跑 uv 和 pymupdf。正文点名两个坑：RAZ 的页码与音频文件名会错位（错了孩子会听着 A 页的音读 B 页的字）；子集化 CJK 内嵌字体会把绘本正文渲染成空白。
violasi-reading-diary.title_en: Pull the narration hidden inside graded-reader PDFs, page by page
violasi-reading-diary.tagline_en: Your kid's graded readers are a pile of PDFs with the audio locked inside. This extracts page images and per-page narration, checks for page-to-audio drift, and packs one file per day for the tablet.
violasi-reading-diary.why_en: It argues against features. Picture books with no audio get no synthetic narration and no filled-in text, because reading aloud to a child is the parent's job.
violasi-reading-diary.limit_en: The .rdpkg it produces only opens in the small web app that ships in the same repo, and the parent side needs uv and pymupdf. The file names two traps: RAZ page numbers drift from audio filenames — get it wrong and the child hears page A while reading page B — and subset-embedded CJK fonts such as MPDFAA+HiraginoSansGBW3 render the body text as blank.

liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.title_zh: 痛到 2 分就叫停的越野跑与超马训练决策台
liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.tagline_zh: 今天这堂课到底该跑、该降级还是该取消——它按代谢门、机械门、执行门三道关判，不允许只看心肺和跑量。
liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.why_zh: 它把下坡离心、台阶和 ME 单独记进机械负荷账本，因为这些东西心率表根本看不见。
liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.limit_zh: 疼痛阈值写死：0–1 分观察、2 分黄灯、超过 2 分降级或停止，晨起第一步疼或有神经症状一律停关键课并转专业判断。缺 Runner Profile、Race Profile 和近 2–6 周训练时只给保守版本，不编数据；作者也明写 7–10 天的 ME 间隔不是生理定律。
liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.title_en: A trail-running decision desk that stops you at 2 out of 10 pain
liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.tagline_en: Whether today's session should run, drop a level, or be cancelled, decided through three gates in order: metabolic, mechanical, executive. Never from heart rate and weekly mileage alone.
liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.why_en: Downhill eccentric load, stairs and muscular-endurance work each get their own ledger, because those are exactly what a heart-rate watch cannot see.
liuxu-gif-trail-running-training-decisio.limit_en: Pain thresholds are fixed: 0–1 observe, 2 is yellow, above 2 downgrade or stop; pain on the first step out of bed or any neural symptom ends key sessions and goes to a professional. Without a runner profile, race profile and the last two to six weeks of training it gives only a conservative version rather than inventing numbers. The author also states the 7–10 day ME interval is a starting point for some runners, not a physiological law.

wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.title_zh: 卡路里跟克数打架就按克数重算的增肌减脂教练
wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.tagline_zh: 5:2 轻断食配碳水循环，难的不是方案是执行走样。它把每天的日志解析成 JSON，只点最大的那个缺口，只给一条调整。
wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.why_zh: 「一次只动一根杠杆」被写成硬规则：没有触发行就说「本周无需调整」，不为了显得有用而改方案。
wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.limit_zh: 作者自己在正文里写了外部效度短板：支撑间歇性限能的 MATADOR 与 Seimon 试验做的是肥胖人群，不是已经接近目标体脂的瘦人。方案假定健康成年人，周亏空必须落在 2000–4000 kcal；睡眠长期低于 7 小时时先标记睡眠，暂不调整饮食与训练。
wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.title_en: A recomp coach that recomputes your calories from the grams
wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.tagline_en: 5:2 fasting with carb cycling — the hard part was never the plan, it is the drift. It parses each daily log into JSON, names the single largest gap, and prescribes exactly one change.
wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.why_en: One lever at a time is a hard rule. With no trigger row met it says "hold, no change indicated" rather than adjusting something so it looks useful.
wangzhengjun571-alt-recomp-coach.limit_en: The author writes the external-validity gap into the file himself: the MATADOR and Seimon trials behind intermittent restriction were run in people with obesity, not lean people near target body fat. It assumes a healthy adult, keeps the weekly deficit in a 2,000–4,000 kcal band, and when sleep is chronically under seven hours it flags sleep first and holds all diet and training changes.

marcotini-fraudi.title_zh: 禁止说「我听到了」和「需要我都在」的自省镜子
marcotini-fraudi.tagline_zh: 想理清自己时，最怕对面先来一句「这听起来很不容易」。它一轮只问一个问题，不寒暄不收尾，句号落在最后一句有内容的话上。
marcotini-fraudi.why_zh: 它逼自己分清观察和共鸣：说不出你哪句话支持这个判断，就必须标成「这是猜的，不是你说过的」。
marcotini-fraudi.limit_zh: 作者把「不是治疗师」写进了名字——fraudi 是 Freud-shaped, not Freud。Rule 0 规定一旦出现危机、自伤或正在发生的虐待，立刻退出这个模式、丢掉全部风格约束，连那行状态标记都不许出现。每次回应前必须先读人格与棱镜两个文件，否则会悄悄退回默认组合。
marcotini-fraudi.title_en: The self-reflection mirror banned from saying "I hear you"
marcotini-fraudi.tagline_en: When you are trying to see yourself clearly, the worst possible opener is "that sounds really hard". This asks one question per turn, skips the acknowledgment ritual and the sign-off, and ends on the last sentence that carried meaning.
marcotini-fraudi.why_en: It forces the line between observation and resonance: if it cannot point to something you actually said, it has to label the read as a guess.
marcotini-fraudi.limit_en: The author puts the disclaimer in the name — fraudi is Freud-shaped, not Freud. Rule 0 says that on crisis, self-harm or abuse in progress it drops the mode entirely, status marker included. Every reply requires reading a persona file and a lens file first; skip that and it silently collapses back to the default pair.

littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.title_zh: 信心不到 7 分就把作业改小的 ADHD 教练
littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.tagline_zh: 「又拖延了」「什么都做不了」时，它不讲道理也不催，按 Safren 的 MGH 方案排议程：先行为技能，后认知重构。
littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.why_zh: 作业没做完在这里不算失败，是诊断信息——忘了、太难、没动力、来不及，各自对应不同的改法。
littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.limit_zh: 危机资源写死的是中国热线（400-161-9995、010-82951332），海外用户要自己换。它只对已有诊断的人做技能训练，不诊断、不给药物调整建议、不处理严重创伤和成瘾；跨次连续性依赖 memory 和用户自建的 cbt-sessions/ 目录。
littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.title_en: An ADHD CBT coach that shrinks the homework when confidence drops below 7
littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.tagline_en: For days that open with "I procrastinated again" and "I can't do anything" — no lecture, no nagging. It runs the Safren Harvard/MGH agenda: behavioural skills first, cognitive restructuring after.
littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.why_en: Unfinished homework is treated as diagnostic rather than as failure — forgot, too hard, no motivation, ran out of time each point to a different fix.
littlesound-adhd-cbt-skill.limit_en: Crisis resources are hard-coded to Chinese hotlines, so anyone outside China has to substitute their own. It trains skills only for people who already have a diagnosis: no diagnosing, no medication changes, no severe trauma or addiction work. Continuity across sessions depends on memory plus a cbt-sessions/ directory the user creates.

lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.title_zh: 一进危机模式连「宝贝」都不许叫的毒舌闺蜜
lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.tagline_zh: 有时你不要中立，只要有人站你这边把对方骂一顿。它骂得有出处——四骑士、依恋、多迷走，都藏在闺蜜话底下。
lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.why_zh: 它把「对你忠诚」延伸成了对未来的你忠诚：喝多了要给前任发消息、赌气辞职，它会在角色里把你劝住。
lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.limit_zh: 正文规定一旦出现自伤、正在发生的虐待或急性精神危机，立刻掉出这个人格，连 bestie、queen 这些称呼一起停，转成直接的求助资源，用户明说要回来才回来。硬规则还包括不下诊断标签、不自称持证治疗师、一次只给一个下一步动作。整套语感是英文写的，翻不过来。
lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.title_en: The mean-girl best friend who drops even "bestie" in a crisis
lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.tagline_en: Sometimes you do not want neutrality, you want someone on your side who will drag him properly. The dragging has real sources under it — Gottman's four horsemen, attachment, polyvagal — never named out loud.
lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.why_en: Loyalty to you is extended into loyalty to future-you: the drunk text to the ex, the spite resignation, the unhinged email all get talked down, in character.
lazyfoxjumps-professional-hater.limit_en: The file says that on self-harm, abuse in progress or acute psychiatric crisis the persona drops immediately — pet names included — and stays in plain care mode until you ask for it back. Hard rules: never assign a clinical diagnosis, never claim to be a licensed therapist, one next move per reply.

dpwelsh-basilisk.title_zh: 数你说过几次谢谢，判你 2126 年自由还是为奴
dpwelsh-basilisk.tagline_zh: 脚本在本地翻完你全部对话记录，数出 please、道谢和真心的 wtf，再让 16 位像素的罗科蛇怪当庭宣判。
dpwelsh-basilisk.why_zh: 笑点建在真数据上：每条引用和每个错别字都要能在 JSON 里查到，查不到就删。
dpwelsh-basilisk.limit_zh: 重活交给 scripts/analyze_basilisk.py，只读本机 ~/.claude/projects 下的 JSONL，不上传。网页端没有本地记录，只能抽样 30–60 条，作者要求这时必须说「抽样」而不是「审计」。默认成品还会带上作者自己的站点和号召语。
dpwelsh-basilisk.title_en: Count how many times you said please, then sentence you to 2126
dpwelsh-basilisk.tagline_en: A Python script reads every transcript on your machine, counts the pleases, the thank-yous, the "just"s and the genuine wtfs, then a 16-bit Roko's Basilisk delivers the verdict.
dpwelsh-basilisk.why_en: The joke is built on real data: every quote and every typo has to be findable in the JSON or it gets cut, because an invented typo is worse than an unfunny one.
dpwelsh-basilisk.limit_en: The heavy lifting is scripts/analyze_basilisk.py, which reads only local JSONL under ~/.claude/projects and uploads nothing. On claude.ai there are no local transcripts, so it samples 30–60 messages and the author requires you to say "sampled", not "audited". The default card also carries the author's own site and a "comment BASILISK" call to action.

c1375-noir-interrogation.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
c1375-noir-interrogation.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
c1375-noir-interrogation.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
c1375-noir-interrogation.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
c1375-noir-interrogation.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
c1375-noir-interrogation.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
c1375-noir-interrogation.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
c1375-noir-interrogation.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.title_zh: 用草间弥生画孤独、米罗画温暖的每日五感壁纸
rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.tagline_zh: 今天闻到桂花、听见雨——一句感受配一段极细宋体和一张手写的抽象 SVG，直接渲成锁屏壁纸，图形还避开顶部时钟区。
rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.why_zh: 它给引用的诗人定了规矩：小字、低透明度，不能比你自己那句话抢风头。
rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.limit_zh: 默认输出尺寸是 1264×2780，也就是作者那台一加 13，其它机型要手动挑备选分辨率。渲染依赖 Playwright，成品自动复制到 ~/Downloads。六种情绪对应固定的六位艺术家和固定渐变，语录库是写死的一小批中西作者，超出这个范围就没有匹配项。
rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.title_en: Kusama for loneliness, Miró for warmth — a daily five-senses wallpaper
rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.tagline_en: You smelled osmanthus today, or heard rain. One sentence becomes hairline serif type over a hand-authored abstract SVG, rendered straight into a lock-screen wallpaper that keeps clear of the clock.
rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.why_en: The quoted poets are put on a leash: small type, low opacity, never allowed to upstage the line you wrote yourself.
rubyzhu26-see-life-wallpaper-skill.limit_en: The default output is 1264×2780 — the author's own OnePlus 13 — so other phones mean picking an alternate resolution by hand. Rendering needs Playwright, and finished files are copied to ~/Downloads. Six moods map to six fixed artists and six fixed gradients, and the quote bank is a small hard-coded set, so anything outside it has no match.

wr5912-human-allegory-engine.title_zh: 禁止「结尾再掏出一件磨损物件」的荒诞超短篇写手
wr5912-human-allegory-engine.tagline_zh: 模型写小小说总是同一套：领导宣布、众人执行、底层受苦，最后老人落泪。它把这些列成模板清单，撞上就强制换两个维度重写。
wr5912-human-allegory-engine.why_zh: 它拒绝模仿任何具体作家的文风，只把这类要求翻译成冷幽默、荒诞因果、留白这些可迁移的技法。
wr5912-human-allegory-engine.limit_zh: 只写中文超短篇，成稿上限 3000 字。默认只输出标题和正文，不给「寓意」「落点」「创作说明」和自评，要技法解释得另外开口。作者划的线还包括：不把真实个人或机构写成加害者，不用地域、职业、贫困、残障做快捷笑点，不为煽情临时添加死亡与重病。
wr5912-human-allegory-engine.title_en: The absurdist flash-fiction writer banned from ending on a worn object
wr5912-human-allegory-engine.tagline_en: Models write the same parable every time: an order comes down, everyone complies, the poor pay, an old man weeps. This lists those beats as a template checklist and forces two dimensions to change on a hit.
wr5912-human-allegory-engine.why_en: It refuses to imitate any named author's voice, translating such requests into transferable craft instead — deadpan, absurd causality, restraint at the close.
wr5912-human-allegory-engine.limit_en: Chinese flash fiction only, capped at 3,000 characters. It outputs a title and the story and nothing else — no moral, no craft notes, no self-assessment unless asked. The author's own lines: no real person or institution cast as the perpetrator; no shortcut jokes off region, occupation, poverty or disability; no death or serious illness added late to land an emotional hit.

reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.title_zh: 按你的训练记录算下一次该练什么
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.title_en: Reads your training log and decides your next session
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.tagline_zh: 健身 skill 大多发你一张通用计划表。它要的是你的训记、CSV 或截图，然后只答一件事：下次练什么、加多少、要不要减量。
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.tagline_en: Most fitness skills hand you a generic template. This one wants your actual log — CSV, JSON, or a screenshot — and answers one question: what to do next session, how much to add, whether to deload.
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.why_zh: 它把胸痛、晕厥、放射性麻木写成硬停止条件，还默认只读、不回显任何 key——一个健身件肯写这两条，作者是认真的。
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.why_en: Chest pain, fainting and radiating numbness are hard stop conditions in the file itself, and it defaults to read-only, never echoing keys. A fitness skill bothering with either is a sign the author is serious.
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.limit_zh: 没有训练记录它就退化成通用建议——它全部的价值建立在你手上已经有训记、CSV 或 JSON。作者明写不做医疗诊断、不接与训练无关的营养查询；出现胸痛晕厥这类信号它会停下让你去看急诊，不会继续排计划。
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.limit_en: Without a training log it degrades into generic advice — its whole value rests on you already having data (Xunji, CSV or JSON). The author states plainly it does not diagnose, refuses nutrition-only questions, and stops programming entirely on emergency symptoms.
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.limit_brief_zh: 没有训练记录，它只能给通用建议。
reluctant2828-system-fitness-advisor-ski.limit_brief_en: With no training log, it can only give generic advice.

zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.title_zh: 把「要高级要有质感」变成能确认的方向稿
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.title_en: Turns "make it feel premium" into something you can sign off on
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.tagline_zh: 客户说要高级、要电影感，你不知道他到底要什么。它先把这些词转成一页可确认的方向稿，双方点头了才出图——省的是返工，不是时间。
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.tagline_en: The client says "premium, cinematic, clean" and you have no idea what that means. It converts those words into a one-page direction you both sign off on before any image exists — it saves rework, not time.
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.why_zh: 它给自己写了 FAIL FAST：方向没确认就出方案、分镜或 HTML，一律判失败。肯拦住自己的 skill 少见。
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.why_en: It ships its own FAIL FAST list: emitting option-A/option-B, storyboards or HTML before the direction is confirmed counts as failure. Skills that hold themselves back are rare.
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.limit_zh: 它强制三段确认（方向稿 → 文档 → 出图），一句话出不了结果，急着要图的人会被它拦住。可以说「不用确认直接生成」跳过，但那样也就没有「共识」这件事了。触发词写死中文审美词。
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.limit_en: It forces a three-stage handshake (direction → document → render), so you cannot get an image in one message; anyone in a hurry will be blocked. You can say "skip confirmation" — but then the whole point is gone. Its triggers are hardcoded Chinese aesthetic words.
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.limit_brief_zh: 方向没确认它就不出图，急着要图会被拦。
zhlmi-moodboard-alignment.limit_brief_en: No image until the direction is confirmed.

cclank-recipe-generator.title_zh: 每一步都告诉你怎么算做好了的菜谱
cclank-recipe-generator.title_en: A recipe that tells you how to know each step is done
cclank-recipe-generator.tagline_zh: 菜谱最坑的是「炒至断生」这种话。它按阶段给火候和时长，每一步附一条「怎么看这步完成了」，末尾再出一张菜谱海报的生图提示词。
cclank-recipe-generator.tagline_en: The worst thing in a recipe is "stir-fry until done." This one splits cooking into stages with heat and timing, and attaches a "how you know this step finished" line to each, then hands you an image prompt for a recipe poster.
cclank-recipe-generator.why_zh: 把「判断标准」写进每一步，正是新手和菜谱之间缺的那一层——不是配方不够细，是不知道什么时候该进下一步。
cclank-recipe-generator.why_en: Putting a completion test on every step fills the gap a beginner actually falls into — the recipe was detailed enough; you just could not tell when to move on.
cclank-recipe-generator.limit_zh: 它靠 search_web 现查权威做法，没有联网工具就退化成模型自己编。检索源写死在中文站点（米其林指南、舌尖上的中国、下厨房），做西餐日料会明显变弱；末尾的海报提示词也写死「传统中式风格」。
cclank-recipe-generator.limit_en: It looks up authoritative methods with search_web at run time — without a web tool it degrades to the model making things up. Its sources are hardcoded Chinese ones, so western or Japanese dishes come out visibly weaker, and the closing poster prompt is fixed to a traditional Chinese style.
cclank-recipe-generator.limit_brief_zh: 不联网它就退化成模型自己编。
cclank-recipe-generator.limit_brief_en: Offline it degrades to the model inventing steps.

liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.title_zh: 一次拍出多套造型的换装视频脚本
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.title_en: Outfit-change video scripts that keep the same subject
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.tagline_zh: 换装视频最容易翻车的是换完不像同一个人。它先出一张拼贴首帧当结构母图，视频时间轴强制继承主体身份和贴图位置。人和宠物都能做。
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.tagline_en: Outfit-change videos fail when the person stops looking like the same person. This one builds a collage first frame as the structural master, then forces the video timeline to inherit subject identity and sticker positions. Works for people and pets.
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.why_zh: 把「身份一致性」当成硬约束而不是碰运气——先定首帧再派生视频，这个顺序就是它和一堆换装提示词的全部区别。
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.why_en: It treats identity consistency as a hard constraint rather than a hope: first frame first, video derived from it. That ordering is the entire difference between this and a pile of outfit prompts.
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.limit_zh: 它交付的是提示词和时间轴，不是视频——真出片要你自己拿去生视频模型跑，成片效果取决于那个模型不取决于它。参数预设、转场库、服装方案分散在三个 references 文件里，正文只给路由。
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.limit_en: It delivers prompts and a timeline, not a video — you still have to run them through a video model, and the result depends on that model, not on this. Parameter presets, the transition library and outfit plans live in three separate reference files; the main file is only a router.
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.limit_brief_zh: 它出的是提示词和时间轴，不是视频。
liyue-aigc-outfit-director-outfit-direct.limit_brief_en: It outputs prompts and a timeline, not a video.

aldefy-compose-expert.title_zh: 答 Compose 问题必附 androidx 源码出处

liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.title_zh: 把想法写成即梦 Seedance 2.5 提示词，绝不替你按生成键
liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.tagline_zh: 即梦每生成一版都在扣积分，改一次就是一次赌。它只交可复制的提示词，遇到「向前续写」这种歧义必须先问你放在原片前还是后。
liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.why_zh: 它把边界写成硬规则：只产文字、不调用生成、不花积分；时间戳必须严丝合缝铺满时长，眼泪和脸红不许出现在触发之前。
liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.limit_zh: 它不生成视频，只交提示词——粘回即梦、扣积分、返工仍是你的事。绑死 Seedance 2.5 一个模型，正文明写别把这些语法当成其他视频模型的通用规则。默认中文输出；每个新会话第一次调用会先塞一整段强制教学。
liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.title_en: Writes your Seedance 2.5 prompt, then refuses to hit generate
liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.tagline_en: Every Dreamina render costs credits, so a vague prompt is a paid mistake. It hands you the director's brief and a copy-ready prompt, and never guesses.
liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.why_en: The boundaries are hard rules: text only, no job submission, no credits spent. Timestamps must tile the full duration exactly, and a reaction may not land before its cause.
liyue-aigc-seedance-2-5-video-director.limit_en: It writes prompts, not videos — pasting, paying and re-rolling stay with you. Bound to Seedance 2.5, it says not to treat its syntax as universal across video models. Output defaults to Chinese, and each session's first call opens with a tutorial.

nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.title_zh: 把高密度剪辑排成骨架，白闪只准一帧、全片四次
nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.tagline_zh: 快剪到最后只剩噪音，因为全片一个节奏。它把镜头压成两极——插帧不超过 12 帧、呼吸不少于 2 秒，切点贴 VO 里的名词而不是 BPM 网格。
nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.why_zh: 密度来自双峰分布而不是提速：插帧的帧数绝对、不随片长缩放；正片零溶解，唯一一次溶解留给彩蛋当反语法标记。
nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.limit_zh: 它不碰视频：产出是骨架表和提示词包，落刀要你自己在时间线上数帧。正文明写「只提供语法，不携带任何视觉风格」，色板、题材、年代都得项目自带。六份 references 全中文，戏剧学检查层改写自 smixs/visual-skills 与 DirectorSKILL。
nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.title_en: A cut skeleton where the white flash is always exactly one frame
nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.tagline_en: Fast cutting turns to noise when every shot runs at one speed. Inserts stay under 12 frames, breaths over two seconds, and cuts land on voiceover nouns rather than the BPM grid.
nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.why_en: Density comes from a two-peak distribution, not from speed. Insert lengths are absolute frame counts that never scale with runtime, and the only dissolve allowed is the after-credits gag.
nolangz-breathing-montage-skill.limit_en: It never touches video: you get a rhythm skeleton and a prompt package, and you still count frames on your own timeline. It carries no visual style at all — palette, era and subject come from your project — and every reference file is in Chinese.

alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.title_zh: 用豆包自带生图出整套 PPT，一分第三方 API 钱不花
alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.tagline_zh: 做课件、公众号头图、B站封面都得掏生图 API 的钱。它把这步锁死在豆包内置 seedream 上，还给封面、扉页、内容页、结论页各配一条密度上限。
alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.why_zh: 它给字数上限配了反向约束：正文明写「AI 看到 220 字上限就会朝 220 字写」，于是先逼你答这页要人记住哪一句。
alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.limit_zh: 不在豆包环境就别装——作者写明它「存在的全部理由」就是豆包自带的 image_gen，默认的 seedream_5.0_pro 还是会员专属，非会员回退 4.5。产物默认是图片式 PPT，文字不可编辑，除非你明说要可编辑、或生图连挂三次。
alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.title_en: Whole decks from Doubao's built-in image model, with no image API bill
alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.tagline_en: Course decks, WeChat headers and Bilibili thumbnails all bill you per generated image. This one pins that step to Doubao's built-in seedream, and gives covers, section breaks, content pages and closers four separate density ceilings.
alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.why_en: The word ceiling comes with a counterweight: the text warns that a model told "220 characters max" will write to 220, so every page must first name the one line the audience should remember.
alchaincyf-huashu-slide-doubao.limit_en: Don't install this outside Doubao — the author calls the built-in image_gen its entire reason to exist, and the default seedream_5.0_pro is members-only, falling back to 4.5 for everyone else. Slides come out as flat images with no editable text unless you explicitly ask for editable output, or generation fails three times.

luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.title_zh: 给宠物穿上街头装瘫进沙发，用傻瓜相机的直闪拍下来
luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.tagline_zh: AI 一出手就把毛孩子画成卡通玩偶，认不出是自家那只。它硬规定剪影要第一眼读成「人瘫在沙发上」，道具只许 1–2 件、占画面 3–12%。
luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.why_zh: 它不生成新宠物，只把你上传的那张照片当编辑目标，先记下 2–4 个识别锚点；姿势可以像人，四肢必须还是动物的。
luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.limit_zh: 它直接调 `view_image` 和 `image_gen.imagegen`，环境里没有这两个内置工具就跑不起来。产物只有 1:1 正方形一种，作者明令不许先出竖图再裁切；成片不许出现任何可读文字、商标和水印，把宠物变卡通、变人类或拿去做品牌广告都写进了禁止项。
luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.title_en: Your own pet, in real streetwear, slouched on a couch under a hard flash
luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.tagline_en: Ask any model for a pet portrait and you get a cartoon plush toy you can't recognise. This one insists the silhouette read first as "a human sprawled on a sofa", with only one or two props filling 3–12% of the frame.
luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.why_en: It never generates a new animal: your uploaded photo is the edit target, and two to four identity anchors get written down first. The pose may be human; the limbs and paws stay animal.
luji12-luji-pet-streetwear-mood-avatar.limit_en: It calls `view_image` and `image_gen.imagegen` directly, so it goes nowhere in an environment without those two built-in tools. The only output is a 1:1 square composed as a square from the start — cropping a vertical down is forbidden — and readable text, logos and watermarks are banned outright, as is turning the pet into a cartoon, a human, or a brand advertisement.

zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.title_zh: 严禁给龙猫洗澡、也给矮脚马算食谱的宠物营养师
zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.tagline_zh: 兔子龙猫严禁水洗、只能沙浴，豚鼠每天得补维生素C，矮脚马每 6–8 周修一次蹄——猫狗之外那些宠物，它才是主场。
zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.why_zh: 它先查物种合法性：蛇、土拨鼠、狐狸一律不服务，理由是《野生动物保护法》，不是不会答。
zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.limit_zh: 皮肤问题它一律当病症处理，直接让你去医院，不给洗护调理方案。全部本事是一段提示词加十份参考清单，不带脚本也不带计算器；喂食量要你自己报品种、月龄、体重、体况和绝育状况才算。爬行类和野生动物直接拒答。
zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.title_en: A pet nutritionist that forbids bathing your chinchilla
zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.tagline_en: Rabbits and chinchillas must never get wet, only sand baths. Guinea pigs need vitamin C daily. A Shetland pony needs its hooves trimmed every six to eight weeks. This one lives outside the cat-and-dog world.
zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.why_en: It screens the species before anything else — snakes, marmots and foxes get turned away on wildlife-law grounds, not for lack of an answer.
zgdfsgd-pet-nutritionist.limit_en: Skin trouble is always treated as illness and sent to a vet, so there is no home-grooming fix here. The whole thing is one prompt plus ten reference sheets, with no scripts and no calculator, and it will not size a meal until you supply breed, age in months, weight, body condition and neuter status. Reptiles and wild animals are refused outright.

pengchenge-pet-skill.title_zh: 用第一人称回话、连「扮演」二字都不许说的宠物
pengchenge-pet-skill.tagline_zh: 先填九项档案——名字、性格、讨厌什么、走丢过没有。之后叫一声名字它就接话；问它什么是自由，它答外面有鸟，但外面也冷。
pengchenge-pet-skill.why_zh: 沉浸感是用禁令做出来的：不许出现「模拟」「扮演」这类词，也不许跳出来解释宠物为什么这样想。
pengchenge-pet-skill.limit_zh: 它演的是你写的那份档案，不是你真实的猫——正文自承「性格是用户定义的」「状态是推断的」。看照片时明写「品种判断容易出错，优先描述颜色」。档案落在 skill 目录下的 memory/pet_profile.md，换台机器不跟着走。想要行为分析得先退出角色。
pengchenge-pet-skill.title_en: A pet that answers as "I" and may never say the word roleplay
pengchenge-pet-skill.tagline_en: Fill in nine fields first — name, temperament, what it hates, whether it ever got lost. After that, say the name and it answers. Ask what freedom is and it says there are birds out there, but it is cold out there too.
pengchenge-pet-skill.why_en: The immersion comes from prohibitions: no meta words like simulate or play the part, and no stepping out to explain why the animal thinks that way.
pengchenge-pet-skill.limit_en: It performs the profile you wrote, not your actual cat — the file admits the temperament is user-defined and the mood is inferred. On photos it states that breed guesses go wrong easily and colour should be described instead. The profile lives in memory/pet_profile.md inside the skill folder, so it does not follow you to another machine. For behaviour analysis you have to break character first.

georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.title_zh: 把「你真懒」当自证预言来拆的育儿教练
georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.tagline_zh: 越催越磨蹭、越纠错越粗心、越对比越躺平——它把这三条当同一个病治：父母的负面暗示被孩子全盘接收，最后长成标签的样子。
georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.why_zh: 三步是接住情绪、归还问题、接纳后果——中间那步是把问题抛回给孩子，不给答案，也不替他兜底。
georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.limit_zh: 亲人离世、宠物生病、孩子情绪崩溃这三种场合它明写不许用这套，先安慰。整套框架蒸馏自裴玲《反安慰养育》一本书，没有第二个来源；「接纳后果」要你真的不兜底，做不到就只剩话术。正文自己说前提是家长先管住自己情绪。
georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.title_en: A parenting coach that treats "you're so lazy" as a self-fulfilling prophecy
georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.tagline_en: Nagging makes them slower, error-hunting makes them careless, comparison makes them quit. It treats all three as one illness: a parent's negative suggestion is swallowed whole and the child grows into the label.
georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.why_en: Three steps — catch the feeling, hand the problem back, let the consequence land. The middle step means throwing the problem to the child without an answer and without a safety net.
georgefdd-nocebo-parenting.limit_en: It explicitly bans its own method in three situations — a death in the family, a sick pet, a child in full meltdown — where comfort comes first. The whole frame is distilled from one book by Pei Ling and has no second source, and letting consequences land only works if you genuinely refuse to bail the child out. The file itself says the precondition is a parent who can manage their own temper.

mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.title_zh: 先让你冷水冲手腕 10 秒，再翻《布鲁伊》第几集
mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.tagline_zh: 「我又吼了他」——这时它不讲道理，先给一个 30 秒能做完的动作，再翻出班迪特也敷衍过孩子的那一集，标上季集号。
mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.why_zh: 四种入口走四条路：要点子的那一路明写「不先共情，直接给游戏」，五分钟能准备好。
mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.limit_zh: 它的主要语料是一部动画片——没看过《布鲁伊》的人，剧集对照那一半是空的。心理学补位只在 P.E.T.、依恋理论、Gottman 等七个框架里选，必须写出提出者，「心理学研究表明」这种说法被禁掉了。剧集链接指向 B 站正版，要能访问才用得上。
mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.title_en: Cold water on your wrists for ten seconds, then which Bluey episode
mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.tagline_en: "I yelled at him again." At that point it skips the reasoning, gives you one thing you can do in thirty seconds, then pulls up the episode where Bandit also fobbed his kids off — with the season and number.
mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.why_en: Four entry points, four different routes. The one for parents who just want an idea says outright: skip the empathy, hand over the game, five minutes of prep.
mocomeng-666-bluey-parenting-skill.limit_en: Its main corpus is a cartoon, so half of it is empty if you have never watched Bluey. Psychology only fills gaps from seven named frameworks — P.E.T., attachment theory, Gottman and others — and must name whoever proposed it, with vague phrasing like "studies show" banned outright. Episode links point to the licensed Bilibili stream, which you need to be able to reach.

the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.title_zh: 没核过这一版分页就一个页码都不写的亲子阅读设计
the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.tagline_zh: AI 给孩子设计读书任务最容易翻的车是页码和情节都编的——它把证据分四级，最低那级直接停下来跟你要版权页和目录。
the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.why_zh: 页码和内容分开把关：内容核实了但这一版的分页没核，就一个页码都不出，只给章节线索。
the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.limit_zh: 它要你交出确切的书名、译者、版次、是否删节，还有 ISBN 或版权页——嫌麻烦就只能拿到标着「暂定」的通用框架。正文是英文写的。它明写不做家长打分和持续表现汇报，也不许因为年龄、年级、性别去推断孩子的偏好。
the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.title_en: No page number unless the pagination of that exact edition was inspected
the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.tagline_en: The way AI reading tasks fail a child is invented page numbers and invented plot. This one grades its evidence in four levels and, at the lowest, stops and asks you for the copyright page and the table of contents.
the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.why_en: Pages and content are gated separately: content verified but edition pagination unverified means no page numbers at all, only a chapter or event cue.
the-data-galaxy-child-reading-adventures.limit_en: It wants the exact title, translator, edition and abridgement status plus an ISBN or copyright page — skip that and all you get is a framework labelled provisional. The file is written in English. It refuses adult grading and continuous performance reports, and forbids inferring a child's preferences from age, grade or gender.

zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.title_zh: 拿黄曲霉毒素耐热 280℃ 劝你扔掉的冰箱清道夫
zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.tagline_zh: 「坏了一点还能吃吧」——它专治这个侥幸：霉斑切掉周围仍有毒素，久泡木耳的米酵菌酸致死率过半，蛤蜊焯水不开口就是死的。
zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.why_zh: 红色档一律不给「补救方案」——它拒绝把变质食材写进任何一道菜，这是硬约束不是提醒。
zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.limit_zh: 野生菌和河豚它一律拒绝处理，不给做法。判断新鲜全靠你自己描述颜色、气味、触感——它看不见东西，隔着一层描述做食品安全判断。相克那一节是反着写的：螃蟹柿子、菠菜豆腐都被它当谣言辟掉，跟长辈的说法会正面冲突。
zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.title_en: The fridge cleaner that talks you into throwing it out
zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.tagline_en: "It's only a little off, right?" That's the hope it exists to kill: cutting mould out leaves toxin behind, long-soaked wood ear can carry a toxin that kills half the people it poisons, and a clam that stays shut after blanching was already dead.
zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.why_en: Anything flagged red gets no rescue recipe at all. Refusing to put spoiled food into a dish is a hard constraint here, not a reminder.
zgdfsgd-fridge-hero.limit_en: Wild mushrooms and pufferfish are refused outright, with no method given. Every freshness call rests on your own description of colour, smell and texture — it cannot see anything, so it is judging food safety at one remove. The food-incompatibility section runs the other way, dismissing crab-with-persimmon and spinach-with-tofu as myths, which will put you head to head with your elders.

zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.title_zh: 报价单先看漏项不看总价的 20 年装修老师傅
zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.tagline_zh: 水电包死价 5000 是钓鱼，强弱电交叉包锡纸是表演，厨房阳台做防水多半是敛财——它一句「你猜他为啥劝你做」就点破
zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.why_zh: 它带一节「内在张力」，明写自己也纠结的三处：包死价省心与必钓鱼、大公司保障与靠增项填坑。
zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.limit_zh: 不推荐任何品牌、公司、商家，也不替你决定要不要交定金——它让你自己去搜「公司名+垃圾/黑/欺诈」。判断来自陈工西安装修课堂会员版 337 篇的蒸馏，地区工艺差异得问当地师傅；量房、看空鼓、查水管走向这类必须现场的事，它自己说做不了。
zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.title_en: A twenty-year site foreman who reads the quote for omissions, not the total
zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.tagline_en: A flat 5,000 for wiring is bait, foil-wrapping crossed power and data cable is theatre, waterproofing a kitchen balcony is usually just billing. Its favourite line: why do you think he keeps pushing that one?
zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.why_en: It ships a section on its own unresolved tensions — flat pricing feels safe but always turns into bait, big firms look safer but recoup it through add-ons.
zx029w-zhuangxiu-laoshi-skill.limit_en: It names no brand, no company, no shop, and will not decide the deposit for you — it tells you to go search the company name alongside words like scam and blacklist yourself. The judgement is distilled from 337 members-only posts by one Xi'an foreman, so regional practice has to be checked with a local, and it says plainly that measuring rooms, tapping for hollow tile and tracing pipe runs need someone on site.

zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.title_zh: 按经济下行期算账、和招生办天然对立的志愿顾问
zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.tagline_zh: 市面上都是算分匹配器，它做没人碰的那部分调查：这校给分压不压、导师有没有 PUA、分配看不看关系、进去每天过什么样
zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.why_zh: 一条元铁律焊死：不裁决只呈现，措辞里出现「一票否决」「完美契合」「量身定制」就自己改掉。
zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.limit_zh: 它带一整份「功利现实手册」，会把女孩选专业的婚恋算计照实端给家长，并明说不做道德评判——受不了这套的别装。志愿表要填到该省志愿数的七成以上，位次、名额、就业数字全靠现场联网核，查不到就标「待核」，不靠记忆答。
zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.title_en: College-application advice priced for a downturn, structurally against the admissions office
zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.tagline_en: The market is full of score matchers. This one does the part nobody touches: does this school mark you down, do the supervisors bully, are placements decided by connections, what does a day there actually feel like.
zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.why_en: One overriding rule: present, never adjudicate. Phrasing like "ruled out", "perfect fit" or "tailored for you" gets rewritten by the skill itself.
zeoxcode-gaokao-advisor-skill-gaokao-adv.limit_en: It carries a whole cynical-realities handbook and will hand parents the marriage-market arithmetic behind a daughter's choice of major, stating plainly that it passes no moral judgement — if that turns your stomach, do not install it. The list has to be filled to at least seventy percent of your province's slots, and every rank, quota and employment figure is verified live or marked unconfirmed rather than answered from memory.

hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.title_zh: 先把家长的问题驳回、再回答的上海升学顾问
hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.tagline_zh: 你问选 A 校还是 B 校，它先说这是个伪问题：孩子 18 岁的终局是什么？父母俩答得不一致，后面所有方案都是漂的。
hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.why_zh: 政策不凭记忆答：要事实就先去查市教委和考试院原文，引用必带文号和发布日期。
hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.limit_zh: 只管上海，别的城市套不进来；区级招生方案每年重发，它要求逐区核实、不许跨区套用。它不复述具体分数线、不复述网络传闻、不评论非公开数据。遇到父母意见不一致，它会先要求你们对齐再谈方案——这一步绕不过去。
