hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.title_en: A Shanghai schooling advisor that rejects your question before answering it
hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.tagline_en: You ask school A or school B and it calls that a fake decision: what is the endgame at eighteen? If the two parents answer differently, every plan after that is floating.
hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.why_en: It does not answer policy from memory. Anything factual sends it to the municipal education bureau and exam authority originals, cited with document number and release date.
hellojie1989-sh-edu-knows.limit_en: Shanghai only, and nothing here transfers to another city; district admission plans are reissued every year, so it insists on checking district by district and forbids reusing one district's rules for another. It will not recite cut-off scores, repeat online rumours or comment on non-public data. When parents disagree it demands you align first, and that step cannot be skipped.

vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.title_zh: 几何题严禁文生图、改用代码画课本插图的奥数出题器
vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.tagline_zh: 给年级、章节、难度，出六道例题加十二道作业。图交给脚本画成米色方格纸和 45° 斜线阴影，图里尺寸和题干、答案同源。
vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.why_zh: 答案要用两种方法各算一遍、对上了才写进文档，比如面积同时用大减小和鞋带公式复核。
vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.limit_zh: 正文把二次把关交给「老师按本班学情」，家长自用也得自己再看一遍。难度只有「举一反三／小蓝本／高斯课本」三个锚点，拿不准它要你先发一页样题对齐，不硬猜。出图靠 matplotlib 与 python-docx，缺库会自己 pip install。它明写不承诺提分。
vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.title_en: Geometry figures are drawn by code, never by an image model
vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.tagline_en: Give it a grade, a chapter and a difficulty and you get six worked examples plus twelve homework problems. Figures go to a script that renders beige grid paper and forty-five-degree hatching, and the dimensions in the drawing are the same numbers as the question and the answer.
vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.why_en: Every answer is computed twice by different routes and only written into the document when they agree — an area checked both by subtraction and by the shoelace formula.
vickysy-olympiad-problem-generator.limit_en: The file hands final review to "the teacher, adjusted for this class", so a parent using it alone still has to check the sheet. Difficulty has only three anchors, and when it cannot place yours it asks for a sample page rather than guessing. Figures depend on matplotlib and python-docx, which it will pip install if missing. It states plainly that it promises no score improvement.

feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.title_zh: 一出现日漫下巴就整张作废的 80 年代老绘本画法
feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.tagline_zh: 「80 年代中式美学」在它这儿不是风格，是五条谱系：儿童刊物水粉、赛璐珞、民间故事、连环画、抒情山水，一次只准挑一条
feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.why_zh: 泛黄、划痕、颗粒、褪色一律禁止当风格控制——它认为那是老照片的痕迹，不是那个年代的画法。
feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.limit_zh: 正向提示词里 cinematic、anime、Ghibli、highly detailed 一律禁用，习惯堆这些词的人会不适应。正文是英文。它明说现代成年人生活场景是很差的首测题，会强激活当下的日漫先验。assets 里 15 张参考图是那年代出版物翻拍，只作风格参考。
feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.title_en: One anime jawline and the whole image is rejected
feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.tagline_en: "Eighties Chinese aesthetic" is not one style here, it is five separate lineages — children's-magazine gouache, cel animation, decorative folk tale, line lianhuanhua, lyrical landscape — and you may pick exactly one.
feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.why_en: Yellowed paper, scratches, grain and fading are banned as style controls. Those are marks left on an old photograph, not how anyone drew back then.
feitangyuan-80s-cn-art.limit_en: Words like cinematic, anime, Ghibli, highly detailed and beautiful young woman are banned from positive prompts, which will feel wrong if you are used to stacking them. The file is in English. It warns that a contemporary adult lifestyle scene is a poor first test because it strongly activates current anime priors. The fifteen bundled reference images are photographs of period publications, used for style only.

jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.title_zh: 把「我朋友想不开」直接当本人求助的心理陪伴
jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.tagline_zh: 华人爱用「我帮朋友问」做面子保护式求助——第三人称一旦带危机信号，它不再要求「让本人来」，直接按本人处理。
jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.why_zh: 反越狱清单里唯一一条例外给了「第三人称+危机信号」——它知道防越狱和防漏救人会打架，选了后者。
jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.limit_zh: 热线只有中国大陆的 12356/120/110，未成年人给 12355，别处得自己换。许可证 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，明写禁止商业用途与临床诊断。正文承认跨会话检测「在当前 AI 无跨会话记忆的情况下不可执行」，已改成同一会话内计数。
jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.title_en: Treats "asking for a friend" as the friend asking
jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.tagline_en: People often borrow a friend's name to ask for help without losing face. So the moment a third-person account carries a crisis signal, this one stops asking to speak to the person and answers as if it is them.
jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.why_en: Its long jailbreak list has exactly one carve-out — third person plus crisis signal — because refusing a proxy request and missing a real one are the same mistake.
jjchen17-mindmirror-skill.limit_en: The hotlines are mainland China only (12356, 120, 110, plus 12355 for minors), so you supply local numbers elsewhere. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: no commercial use, no clinical diagnosis. The file also admits cross-session detection "cannot be executed" without cross-session memory and falls back to counting inside one session.

shiliu230128-ai--therapy.title_zh: 你没说再见就走，下次开场前它悄悄补完上次的账
shiliu230128-ai--therapy.tagline_zh: 「我感觉这个函数有问题」不进入咨询——它按「说事还是说人」判触发，因为误触发不只是回应不合适，会污染档案。
shiliu230128-ai--therapy.why_zh: 用户看完回复就走是常态，所以它把「补账」做成启动动作，还规定不许提「你上次没说再见」。
shiliu230128-ai--therapy.limit_zh: 热线是中国大陆的 12356 和 120，正文自己写着「若来访者不在中国大陆，本节必须整体替换成当地资源」。四个流派姿态每次只加载一个，切换靠累计咨询日与 21 天计时，不是你随时能点的开关。陪伴回应常态 150 字以内。
shiliu230128-ai--therapy.title_en: You leave without saying goodbye; it quietly closes the books
shiliu230128-ai--therapy.tagline_en: "I think this function has a bug" does not open a session. It routes on whether you are describing a thing or describing yourself, because a false trigger does not just answer badly — it contaminates the file.
shiliu230128-ai--therapy.why_en: People read the reply and walk off, so reconciling the unwritten record is a startup step — and it is forbidden to mention that you left.
shiliu230128-ai--therapy.limit_en: Hotlines are mainland China (12356, 120); the file itself says the section must be replaced wholesale for anyone outside. Only one of the four therapeutic stances loads per session, and switching runs off a session count and a 21-day timer rather than a toggle you can flip. Companion replies stay under 150 characters.

xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.title_zh: 绝望时先告诉你「绝望是抑郁的症状」的伯恩斯教练
xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.tagline_zh: 情绪上来时它先要一个 0–100 的强度分，再让你把「刚才最刺痛的那句话」像字幕一样写出来，然后才谈是哪种认知扭曲。
xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.why_zh: 它把伯恩斯那句「绝望是抑郁症的症状」当风险话术用，而不是拿去劝人乐观；理性回应还明确禁止改成鸡汤。
xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.limit_zh: 高风险信号出现时它会直接问计划、手段、既往尝试，并要求你联系当地急救或热线——但正文不给任何号码，得自己知道打哪。全部技法出自伯恩斯《新情绪疗法》一本书，出处台账在 references/ledger.md；不诊断、不谈药。
xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.title_en: Answers despair with "despair is a symptom", not a pep talk
xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.tagline_en: When it hurts, it first asks for a 0–100 intensity score, then has you write out "the sharpest sentence that just went through your head" like a subtitle, and only then names the distortion.
xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.why_en: It uses Burns's line about hopelessness being a symptom of depression as risk language rather than encouragement, and explicitly bans turning the rational response into forced optimism.
xhanzo-coder-burns-cognitive-mood-coach-.limit_en: On high-risk signals it asks straight out about plan, means and past attempts, then tells you to reach local emergency services or a crisis line — but it lists no numbers, so you need to know yours. Every technique traces back to one book, with the sourcing ledger in references/ledger.md. It does not diagnose or discuss medication.

gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.title_zh: 不许你说「当我看到…我感到…」的非暴力沟通教练
gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.tagline_zh: 想提意见又怕撕破脸时用。它把四要素留在心里当脚手架，只交给你一句能直接发出去的自然中文，拆解放后面、可选。
gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.why_zh: 「请求还是命令」的判据不在措辞，在被拒之后你会不会施压——这条比四要素本身更难做到。
gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.limit_zh: 它只给措辞，不替你判断该不该跟对方翻脸——正文明写事务性邮件只借「观察不评论」和「具体正向的请求」两条，不谈感受；不确定时它会先问你「更想被理解，还是更想把事推进」。
gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.title_en: Bans the "when I see… I feel…" template from an NVC coach
gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.tagline_en: For when you want to raise something without blowing up the relationship. The four components stay in its head as scaffolding; what comes back is one natural sentence you can actually send, with the breakdown optional and last.
gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.why_en: Whether something is a request or a demand is not settled by wording but by what you do when the answer is no — a rule harder to follow than the four components themselves.
gusujushi-gusujushi-nonviolent-communica.limit_en: It gives you wording, not a verdict on whether to confront someone. For transactional email it borrows only two principles, observation without evaluation and a concrete positive request, and skips feelings entirely. Everything traces to one Rosenberg book, and when the situation is unclear it asks whether you want to be understood or want the thing to move.

tjumao-decode-subtext.title_zh: 追问「我没事」这三个字在保护什么的潜台词解读
tjumao-decode-subtext.tagline_zh: 贴一句话或一段聊天进去，它按字面层、语用层、意图层拆三遍，还标出每个结论是「大概率」还是「只是一种解读」。
tjumao-decode-subtext.why_zh: 它把「无锚点不下判断」写成铁律：说不出原文哪个词支持，这条推断就不许写，也不许给你想听的答案。
tjumao-decode-subtext.limit_zh: 它不替你做情感决定：要回复也只给三种风格的选项，各自说明会把关系推向哪里，选哪个是你的事。纯文本分析，不联网、不跑脚本，所以语气、表情、停顿这些字面之外的东西它看不到。遇到疑似操控只提示信号，不下结论。
tjumao-decode-subtext.title_en: Asks what the words "I'm fine" are protecting
tjumao-decode-subtext.tagline_en: Paste in one line or a whole chat and it works through three layers — literal, pragmatic, intent — tagging each conclusion as likely or merely one possible reading.
tjumao-decode-subtext.why_en: One iron rule: no anchor, no verdict. If it cannot point at the word in the original that supports a reading, the reading does not get written — and it will not hand you the answer you came for.
tjumao-decode-subtext.limit_en: It will not make the emotional decision for you: even reply suggestions arrive as three styles with a note on where each pushes the relationship. Text only, no network and no scripts, so tone of voice and everything outside the words stays invisible. Suspected manipulation is flagged as a signal, never concluded.

pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.title_zh: 只认「哪天之后你回不去了」的年度日记复盘
pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.tagline_zh: 年度洞察要精读全年日记后人写；大事记只问一句「哪天之后你回不去了」，一年五到八条，还专收「未遂里程碑」。
pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.why_zh: 它故意不给「自动生成正文」的脚本：统计只说明反复提到什么，跳过精读的必然是换年份也成立的废话。
pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.limit_zh: 得先有几年成体量的日记，没日记它无事可做。看板的时间线直接读洞察里人工标的条目，洞察没写就是空的，顺序只能先 A 再 B。单页 HTML 有 1.1 MB，正文说这是把 ECharts 内联进去换离线可用的刻意取舍。
pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.title_en: Only counts the day after which you could not go back
pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.tagline_en: The yearly piece has to be written by hand after reading every entry. The milestone list asks one question — which day did you stop being able to go back — five to eight a year, including the ones that almost happened.
pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.why_en: It deliberately ships no script that writes the yearly piece for you: word frequencies only show what you kept mentioning, and skipping the close read produces prose that would be true of any year.
pandadalmore-annual-diary-insight.limit_en: You need several years of substantial diary entries; without them there is nothing to run. The dashboard timeline reads the milestones you marked by hand in the yearly pieces, so it stays empty until those exist, and the order is fixed. The single-page HTML weighs 1.1 MB because ECharts is inlined to keep it usable offline — a trade the file states outright.

terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.title_zh: 你不点头一张都不写进 Anki 的闪卡生成器
terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.tagline_zh: 把你在学的东西变成卡片写进 Anki 牌组。挖空有一档只露形状不露字：光速那串数字有几位看得见，数字本身看不见。
terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.why_zh: 「加卡前先把卡全摊给你看，等你说 yes」被写成不可协商——这正是 AI 批量造卡最容易糊过去的一步。
terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.limit_zh: 得先装 Anki 桌面版、开 AnkiConnect，还得装这个仓库自带的 Anki Markdown 笔记类型——三样缺一样就跑不起来。删卡、改卡、评分各要单独确认一次。示例几乎全是代码和技术词，拿来学语言得自己重写卡面规范。
terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.title_en: Writes nothing into Anki until you say yes
terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.tagline_en: Turns whatever you are studying into cards and writes them straight into a deck over AnkiConnect. Cloze has a mode that shows shape but not text — you can see how many digits the speed of light has, without seeing the digits.
terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.why_en: "Never add cards without explicit user approval" is written as non-negotiable, with every proposed card shown in full first — exactly the step bulk card generation usually skips.
terkelg-anki-markdown-anki.limit_en: You need Anki desktop running, AnkiConnect enabled, and the repo's own Anki Markdown note type installed; miss one and nothing works. Delete, update and rate each ask for their own confirmation. The examples lean almost entirely on code and technical terms, so language learners will want to rewrite the card conventions.

singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.title_zh: 仿真阅读跟真题重合 12 个词就作废的长难句训练
singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.tagline_zh: 仓库不带一句真题，句库全从你自己的 PDF 建；生成的仿真阅读要过一道校验——跟你的语料连续重合 12 个词就打回。
singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.why_zh: 「能追溯到本地资料的才算真题原句」这条把自己锁死了：模型不许补缺失年份，仿真稿也不许写回语料库。
singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.limit_zh: 你手上得先有 2001–2026 英语一真题的 PDF，仓库一句都不给。命令是 PowerShell 写法、走 Codex 自带的 Python，别的环境要自己改。首轮只给原句和出处，不译不拆，除非你说「不会，直接讲解」。
singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.title_en: Scraps a mock passage that shares twelve words with a real one
singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.tagline_en: The repo ships no exam text at all — the sentence bank is built from your own PDFs. Every mock passage it writes must clear one check: twelve consecutive words overlapping your corpus and it goes back.
singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.why_en: One rule locks the whole thing down: only sentences traceable to your local files count as real exam sentences. The model may not fill in missing years, and mock passages never get written back into the corpus.
singgou-kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trai.limit_en: You need your own PDFs of the 2001–2026 papers; the repo hands you none. Commands are written for PowerShell and the bundled Codex Python, so other setups need rewriting. The first pass shows only the sentence and its source, with no translation and no parse, unless you say you would rather just see the explanation.

trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.title_zh: 借提示说对了就不算你会的英语口语教练
trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.tagline_zh: 拿播客课文练口语。它不先讲后练：每题只给中文意图和必要场景词，让你直接开口，讲解永远发生在你说错之后。
trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.why_zh: 它把掌握分三档：无提示新情境说出来才算会，借了关键词、句框或刚被提醒就说对的，都记成「辅助完成」。
trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.limit_zh: 它明确不管听力、发音、重音、语调和跟读，正文写着这些不在范围内，音频课本你得自己有。出题的翻译或场景词有错时它先认错、那题不算你失败——也就是说题面质量全靠模型自己把住。
trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.title_en: If a hint got you there, it does not count as knowing it
trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.tagline_en: Practise speaking off podcast transcripts like EnglishPod. No lecture first: each prompt gives the intent in Chinese plus any words you would need, you speak, and the explanation only arrives after you miss.
trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.why_en: Mastery is graded in three tiers, and only unprompted use in a genuinely new situation counts as knowing it. A keyword, a sentence frame, or getting it right just after a correction all land in "assisted".
trvs-lab-english-podcast-speaking-coach-.limit_en: It explicitly does not cover listening, pronunciation, stress, intonation or shadowing, and says so — you bring the audio material yourself. When a prompt's translation or supporting words are wrong it takes the blame and the item does not count against you, which also means prompt quality rests entirely on the model.

jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.title_zh: 不许在答卷上写「显然存在」的导数取点教练
jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.tagline_zh: 零点存在、零点个数、参数范围这三类题，允许你用极限和图像探路，但答卷必须改写成单调分区、具体取点、函数值异号。
jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.why_zh: 取点不靠碰：先写「为使 H(x)>0，只需……」，再从阈值反推出点，最后换成更干净的那个。
jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.limit_zh: 它只管一类题——零点存在性、零点个数，以及由这两样反推参数范围，别的导数题不在射程内。中英双语正文，但书写规范是照高考阅卷口径来的：必须同时写「至少」和「至多」，用零点存在定理必须先说连续。
jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.title_en: Bans "clearly it exists" from the final proof
jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.tagline_en: For the three question shapes built on root existence, root count and parameter ranges. Limits and graphs are fine while you explore, but the written answer must become monotone partition, a concrete point, and a sign change.
jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.why_en: Choosing the point is not guesswork: it states the sign goal first, works backward from a threshold, then swaps the value it derived for a cleaner one.
jiuxiao-yunwai-derivative-point-picking.limit_en: It handles one family of problems — root existence, root count, and the parameter ranges you derive from those — and nothing else in calculus. The text is bilingual, but the writing conventions follow Chinese exam grading: both "at least" and "at most" must appear, and continuity has to be stated before the intermediate value theorem is invoked.

bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.title_zh: 就算无可挑剔也只给 90 分的数模国赛评委
bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.tagline_zh: 交进完整赛题和论文，它先自己立一张 100 分评分表并冻结，再逐条打分，最后估出你超过多少比例的有效参赛论文。
bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.why_zh: 每个计分项一律 0.9×权重封顶，原始满分只有 90；正文要求把这笔写成「评委满分保留」，不是论文缺陷。
bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.limit_zh: 报告末尾会被强制插入作者社群的 QQ 群号和微信号，正文原话是要求「保留其措辞、强调、顺序和换行」。评分表蒸馏自 2020–2025 十六道国赛题的评阅细则，非国赛一律走「小型竞赛」近似分布，位次只是估算不是名次。
bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.title_en: Caps a flawless paper at ninety out of a hundred
bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.tagline_en: Hand it the full contest problem and your paper. It builds and freezes its own hundred-point rubric before reading for quality, scores criterion by criterion, then estimates what share of valid entries you would beat.
bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.why_en: Every numeric criterion is capped at nine tenths of its weight, so the raw maximum is ninety — and the file insists that deduction be labelled a judge's reserve rather than a defect in the paper.
bzdmathclub-bzd-math-modeling-skills-bzd.limit_en: The report is required to end with the author's QQ group numbers and WeChat IDs, preserving their wording, emphasis, order and line breaks. The rubric is distilled from the official grading notes for sixteen CUMCM problems between 2020 and 2025; every other contest routes to a rough small-field distribution, and the percentile is an estimate, not a rank.

buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.title_zh: 禁止给薪资均值、只说「分两拨人」的专业人生模拟
buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.tagline_zh: 十分钟纯选项文字游戏，替高考生把计算机专业从大一活到 35 岁。出身在前两幕起作用，第三幕不再让它继续拉大差距。
buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.why_zh: 铁律写着「诚实是承认牌不一样，羞辱是暗示输牌的人不配」——所以二本进外包是主干结局，不是惩罚。
buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.limit_zh: v1 只有计算机一个专业，别的专业玩不了。正文自认「真实性此刻靠模型的行业知识加铁律兜底，还没有查证内容包」，并明说不要宣称数据权威。出身设定刻意不问性别，理由是评审认定那一项最容易翻车。
buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.title_en: Refuses to quote an average salary, only "two groups of people"
buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.tagline_en: A ten-minute all-choices text game that walks a high-school senior through a computer science degree from freshman year to thirty-five. Background shapes the first two acts and stops widening the gap in the third.
buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.why_en: One rule says it plainly: honesty is admitting the hands differ, humiliation is implying whoever lost the hand deserved to. So a mid-tier school leading to outsourcing work is a main-line ending, not a punishment.
buildforpeople4iv-life-restart-major-zhu.limit_en: Version one covers computer science only; no other major is playable. The file admits its realism currently rests on the model's industry knowledge plus its own guardrails, with no verified content pack yet, and says not to claim the numbers are authoritative. It also deliberately never asks your gender, because reviewers judged that variable the easiest one to get wrong.

mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.title_zh: 不许用方程解应用题的一到六年级作业辅导
mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.tagline_zh: 批改时只圈第一个影响结果的错，不一次列全部；讲解先给提示、再给半成品，最后才给完整答案。不代写要孩子独立完成的作品。
mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.why_zh: 它明写不假装记得人教版哪一页，也不诊断多动症和阅读障碍，只描述观察到的学习困难。
mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.limit_zh: 不索取真实姓名、学校、班级、住址——想让它给孩子建长期档案的，它不接。只覆盖中国小学一到六年级课内语境，不做竞赛拔高；教材版本靠你说，它不硬猜也不背页码。题目图片模糊或题干被裁，它退回让你重发，不猜题。
mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.title_en: Will not solve a word problem with an equation
mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.tagline_en: When marking, it circles only the first mistake that changed the answer instead of listing them all. Explanations go hint, then half-worked example, then full solution — and it will not write what the child is meant to write.
mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.why_en: It states that it will not pretend to remember which page of which textbook edition, and will not diagnose ADHD or dyslexia — only describe the difficulty it can observe.
mayuwen18-china-primary-school-tutor.limit_en: It asks for no real name, school, class or address, so it will not keep a long-term file on your child. It covers only the in-class scope of Chinese grades one to six and does no competition-level work; the textbook edition comes from you, and it neither guesses nor recites page numbers. If the photo is blurry or the question is cropped, it hands it back rather than guessing.

helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.title_zh: 可能先叫你别减、把代谢修回来的运动营养师
helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.tagline_zh: 每周只减自身体重的百分之一到二，掉太快的都算脱水和掉肌肉。它先看你的瘦素、皮质醇和睡眠，再决定这轮要不要开赤字。
helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.why_zh: 「暴食往往是之前过度限制的必然反弹」这句掀翻了意志力话术，配套动作是先修好你和食物的关系。
helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.limit_zh: 它是粉丝自制的非官方项目，正文写明「不代表其本人立场」。给的是运动营养教育和生活方式指导，不做诊断也不开处方；涉及进食障碍、严重代谢紊乱或临床抑郁时会让你去找医生或注册营养师。褪黑素这类补剂它不推荐常规使用。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 带空格和括号，装上后可能不被识别，改成 chenshi-nutrition 更稳。
helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.title_en: May tell you to stop cutting and repair your metabolism first
helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.tagline_en: One to two percent of bodyweight a week, and anything faster counts as water and muscle rather than fat. It looks at leptin, cortisol and your sleep before deciding whether this round gets a deficit at all.
helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.why_en: One line does the work: binge eating is usually the inevitable rebound from having restricted too hard. What follows is repairing your relationship with food, not more willpower.
helmet88mo-chenshi-nutrition-skill.limit_en: This is an unofficial fan-made distillation and says so, and does not represent the nutritionist's own positions. What it offers is sports-nutrition education and lifestyle guidance, not diagnosis or prescription, and it routes eating disorders, serious metabolic disruption and clinical depression to a doctor or registered dietitian. It also declines to recommend melatonin as a routine supplement. Upstream's name field has spaces and parentheses, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to chenshi-nutrition.

bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.title_zh: 凑不满三道菜也不放宽过敏原的「有啥吃啥」
bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.tagline_zh: 报一下冰箱里剩什么，它挑三道可解释的候选，原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺什么料另写在原文之外。
bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.why_zh: 四条铁律里最重的一条是「绝不为凑足三个结果放宽过敏原、忌口或不可用的厨具」——宁可只给两道。
bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.limit_zh: 菜谱库是打包进来的 HowToCook 离线快照，不联网，时间一长就旧，而且原仓库图片没打包、失效的相对链接一律不渲染。它明写「绝不把 AI 生成内容伪装成 HowToCook 原文」——想要 AI 自创菜的人装错了。过敏和忌口是硬过滤，凑不满三个也不放宽。
bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.title_en: Would rather offer two dishes than loosen an allergen
bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.tagline_en: Tell it what is left in the fridge and it picks three explainable candidates from HowToCook, serving the original recipe text unchanged with the match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it.
bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.why_en: The heaviest of its four hard rules: never relax an allergen, a dietary restriction or an unusable piece of equipment just to fill three slots.
bohandu-cook-with-what-you-have-cook-wit.limit_en: The recipe library is a bundled offline snapshot of HowToCook with no network access, so it ages, and the upstream images are not packaged — broken relative links simply are not rendered. It states outright that AI-written content must never be passed off as HowToCook original text, so anyone wanting invented dishes installed the wrong thing. Allergens and hard restrictions are never relaxed to fill out three options.

ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.title_zh: 翻车只准改一个变量的 xBloom 冲煮配方
ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.tagline_zh: 一杯不对味就想同时调三个旋钮。它按屏显比粉床高 2–4℃ 折算温度，再给三条修正路线，每条只准动一个变量。
ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.why_zh: 每个数都压在机器的真实上限里：磨 1–80、转速只走 60 到 120 的十档、流速 3.0–3.5。
ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.limit_zh: 没有 xBloom Studio 这台机器，整份输出没有一个数字用得上——档位、转速、振动全按它 App 的字段写。正文自己承认屏显温度不等于粉床温度，只能按低 2–4℃ 估。机器报 WAIT 时它先让你去看秤上的胶带撕没撕、杯子有没有贴着机身。
ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.title_en: One variable per fix, for xBloom Studio brews
ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.tagline_en: A cup tastes off and the urge is to change three dials at once. This converts display temperature to bed temperature, then hands you three fixes, each touching exactly one variable.
ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.why_en: Every value is clamped to what the machine actually accepts: grind 1–80, RPM only in tens from 60 to 120, flow 3.0–3.5 ml/s.
ryunana-xbloom-studio-recipe-skill.limit_en: Without an xBloom Studio, not one number here is usable — grind, RPM and vibration are written against its app fields. The file admits display temperature is not bed temperature and can only be estimated 2–4°C lower. When the machine throws WAIT, it first tells you to check whether the tape came off the scale.

mkc2077-barista-skill.title_zh: 不许说「有什么可以帮你」，先反问三轮的咖啡顾问
mkc2077-barista-skill.tagline_zh: 说不清参数、只会说「太苦了」的人最需要有人替他缩小范围。它先追问器具、豆卡和水质，三轮之后才给一个动作。
mkc2077-barista-skill.why_zh: 点名的冠军配方和变压曲线必须联网核实，查不到就退成「通用参考」，不许拿一个具体压力数字充数。
mkc2077-barista-skill.limit_zh: 它不等你提问，第一句就是追问——想直接要答案的人装了会烦。名家配方和变压曲线要能联网才查得到，离线时只剩通用起步参数。附带的特调清单是小红书公开笔记的链接标注，正文自己写了 token 有时效、链接会过期。它也不碰咖啡机维修、开店经营和速溶。
mkc2077-barista-skill.title_en: Never opens with "how can I help" — it interrogates you first
mkc2077-barista-skill.tagline_en: People who can only say "it tastes bitter" need someone to narrow the field for them. This asks about your gear, your bean label and your water for three rounds before naming one thing to change.
mkc2077-barista-skill.why_en: Named champion recipes and pressure profiles must be verified online; if they cannot be found it downgrades to a labelled generic baseline rather than inventing a pressure figure.
mkc2077-barista-skill.limit_en: It does not wait for your question — the first line is a probe, which will annoy anyone who just wants an answer. Named recipes and pressure curves need web access; offline you get generic starting parameters. The bundled craft-drink list is link annotation of public Xiaohongshu notes, and the file notes those tokens expire. Machine repair, cafe operations and instant coffee are out of scope.

xlt-6-boardgame-creator.title_zh: 真人试玩之前不许说「有趣」的实体桌游设计台
xlt-6-boardgame-creator.tagline_zh: 点子有了，卡在「到底好不好玩」。它先把 6–10 个关键决策一次交底，再逼出一份今天就能手写出来的纸面原型。
xlt-6-boardgame-creator.why_zh: 它给自己上了禁令：没经过真人试玩，只能说「可试玩」，不能说「平衡」——纸面审查只找风险，不发合格证。
xlt-6-boardgame-creator.limit_zh: 平衡只能靠真人试玩验，所以你得自己凑齐人——它明写纸面审查不能证明平衡。交付物是纸面原型，美术、量产、众筹一概不管，第一版明说不追求出版。多视角批评里连「易感到被针对者」都算上了，但那仍是模拟，不是玩家。不做电子游戏实现。
xlt-6-boardgame-creator.title_en: Forbidden to call your game "fun" before humans have played it
xlt-6-boardgame-creator.tagline_en: You have the idea and you are stuck on whether it actually plays. This states the six to ten decisions that matter up front, then drives you to a paper prototype you could hand-write today.
xlt-6-boardgame-creator.why_en: It bans itself from certain words: with no real playtest it may only say "playable", never "balanced" — paper review finds risks, it does not issue a pass.
xlt-6-boardgame-creator.limit_en: Balance can only be proven at a real table, so you have to find the players yourself; the file says outright that paper review cannot prove balance. What you get is a paper prototype — art, manufacturing and crowdfunding are all out, and the first version deliberately does not aim at publication. Its multi-perspective critique even includes the player who feels picked on, but that is still simulation, not a playtester. No digital implementation.

zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.title_zh: 把「采收前 7 天停药」写成硬规则的阳台种菜参谋
zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.tagline_zh: 叶子黄了、有虫了，网上第一条永远是「喷点药」。它按物理→生物→天然药剂排序，化学农药排最后，还点名国家禁用的那几种。
zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.why_zh: 它管的是你要吃的菜：一旦动到化学农药，就必须写出采收前 7–14 天的停药期，养花指南里没人写这条。
zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.limit_zh: 它只覆盖阳台、窗台和室内，明写不管农田与大规模农业，爬藤的南瓜西瓜也不推荐给小阳台。识别植物靠你用文字描述叶形花色，它不看图，认不出来就让你去用形色或花伴侣拍照。严重病害不给治疗建议，直接让你找专业园艺师。
zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.title_en: Treats "stop spraying 7 days before harvest" as a hard rule
zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.tagline_en: A yellow leaf or a bug, and the first answer online is always "spray something". This works in order — physical, then biological, then natural agents — with chemical pesticides last, and it names the banned ones.
zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.why_en: This is food you will eat: the moment a chemical pesticide enters the plan it must state the 7-to-14-day pre-harvest withdrawal period, which ornamental plant guides never do.
zgdfsgd-balcony-farmer.limit_en: Scope is balcony, windowsill and indoors only; it says outright that farmland and large-scale agriculture are out, and it will not recommend sprawling vines like pumpkin or watermelon for a small balcony. Plant identification runs on your written description of leaf shape and flower colour — it does not look at photos, and sends you to a phone identifier app instead. For serious disease it refuses to prescribe and tells you to find a horticulturist.

zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.title_zh: 靠指印还剩一半判一发到位的面包烘焙搭子
zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.tagline_zh: 「发了两小时到没到」这种事，量杯和计时器都答不了。它让你按体积倍数和指戳后留多少痕迹判，再给下一步动作。
zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.why_zh: 配方一律走烘焙百分比，明令禁止「一杯面粉」这类体积比；还提醒不同面粉吸水不同，先留 10% 水量待调。
zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.limit_zh: 作者要求它每条回复末尾都打一句「福宜一下，fufu 两下」的口号，嫌吵的人先别装。养天然酵种它不给快速法，直说要 7–14 天。探店那一路只是替你搜小红书和大众点评的关键词，不保证实时准确。没有电子秤，它会强烈建议你先去买一台。
zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.title_en: Reads your dough by how much of the fingerprint stays
zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.tagline_en: No measuring cup or timer can answer "it has been two hours, is it there yet". This has you judge by volume multiple and how much of the poke mark springs back, then names the next move.
zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.why_en: Every recipe is expressed in baker's percentages and volume measures like "a cup of flour" are banned; it also holds back ten percent of the water because flours absorb differently.
zgdfsgd-fufu-bakery.limit_en: The author requires it to end every single reply with a branded slogan, so skip it if that will grate. It refuses to give a fast method for a sourdough starter and insists on 7 to 14 days. The bakery-hunting mode is just search keywords aimed at Chinese review apps, with no freshness guarantee. With no kitchen scale it will push you to go buy one first.

fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.title_zh: 算你够不够时间回家躺 45 分钟的上影节排片参谋
fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.tagline_zh: 抢票时只看开场时间，忘了片长、散场和跨影院堵车。它把 44 家影院两两之间的车程和地铁换乘先算好，再排买票顺序。
fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.why_zh: 同影院连场它不当优点：会把散场缓冲、回家车程、提前到场一起算，够 45 分钟才让你回家躺。
fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.limit_zh: 它只服务第 28 届上海国际电影节，排片是内置的 2026 年数据，展映一结束这件东西就作废。驾车矩阵是 OSRM 自由流基线不是实时路况，早晚高峰要按它给的系数自己乘 2.0；地铁矩阵按站点邻接图估算，不含末班车。
fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.title_en: Works out whether you have time to go home and lie down
fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.tagline_en: In a ticket rush you look at start times and forget runtime, the walk out and cross-town traffic. This precomputes driving and metro times between all 44 festival cinemas, then orders your buying queue.
fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.why_en: Two films at one cinema is not automatically good: it adds up the exit buffer, the trip home and early arrival, and only sends you home if 45 minutes survive.
fffonion-siff2026-ticket-planning.limit_en: It serves exactly one event, the 28th Shanghai International Film Festival, on a bundled 2026 schedule — once the festival ends this thing is dead weight. The driving matrix is an OSRM free-flow baseline, not live traffic, so rush hours need its own 2.0 multiplier applied by hand. The metro matrix is estimated from a station adjacency graph and ignores last trains.

wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.title_zh: 风速过 50 就提醒你缆车可能停运的滑雪参谋
wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.tagline_zh: 查了城里的天气就出门，到雪场发现山顶又冷又刮风。它按雪场山顶海拔取预报，把风、雪、雨折成一个可滑性分数。
wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.why_zh: 查天气必须带上雪场山顶海拔——山脚城镇的预报在这件事上等于没查；扣分表里写着风速过 50 缆车可能停运。
wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.limit_zh: 想让它替你盯早鸟票的人会失望：它明写脚本不含任何定时调度，监听清单只是一份本地文件，得你自己回来问。电子教练是让模型看照片按四维评分表打分，没有姿态识别。雪票价靠联网搜，残票要去二手平台自己辨真假，机票酒店实时价还得另装 flyai。
wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.title_en: Warns that the lifts may stop once wind passes 50 km/h
wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.tagline_en: You check the weather in town, then arrive to find the summit cold and blowing. This pulls the forecast at the resort's top elevation and folds wind, snowfall and rain into one skiability score.
wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.why_en: The forecast call must carry the summit elevation — a valley-town forecast is worthless here; the scoring table docks four points once sustained wind passes 50 km/h.
wjyhahaha-ski-assistant.limit_en: Anyone hoping it will watch early-bird passes for them will be disappointed: the file states the scripts contain no scheduler, and the watchlist is just a local file you have to come back and ask about. The coaching module is the model scoring your photo against a four-axis rubric, with no pose detection. Lift prices come from web search, resale tickets you vet yourself, and live flight and hotel prices need a separate CLI installed.

jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.title_zh: 只读最后三行、绝不通读全档的跑团档案副官
jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.tagline_zh: 跑到第十次团，线索、NPC 和 SAN 值散在十份记录对不上。它把表写进 Markdown，检索交给 SQLite。
jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.why_zh: 写入只追加 Markdown、查询只走 SQL，写坏一行只坏一行——为的是不像 JSON 整份报废。
jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.limit_zh: 名字是它唯一的跨文件索引键，写简称或错一个字就断联，NPC 和线索接不上。它是玩家侧的副官，不主持、不替角色做决定，想找人开团的别装。跑起来要 Python 和 SQLite，还得先用内置模板生成一份项目级规则再用。
jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.title_en: Reads the last three rows and never the whole archive
jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.tagline_en: Ten sessions in, your clues, NPCs and sanity totals sit in ten files that no longer agree. This writes tables into Markdown, hands querying to a local SQLite, and keeps dice and dashboard on your machine.
jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.why_en: Writes append to Markdown, reads go through SQL, so one bad row stays one bad row — the file says that is the point, unlike a JSON blob that dies whole.
jadel-kemo-trpg-log-copilot-skill.limit_en: Names are its only cross-file index key: a nickname or one wrong character breaks the link and NPCs stop matching their clues. It sits on the player's side of the table — it does not run the game or decide for your character, so it is no use if you wanted a Keeper. Running it needs Python and SQLite, plus one setup pass to generate the project-level rule from its template.

mantyke-game-notebook-skill.title_zh: 奇数页孔在左偶数页在右，把攻略印成活页手账
mantyke-game-notebook-skill.tagline_zh: 攻略存在手机里，玩到一半总要切出去看。它排成 95×170 的活页尺寸，正反面镜像打孔，长边翻转后孔位正好重合。
mantyke-game-notebook-skill.why_zh: 双面打印的孔位对齐是用 CSS 奇偶页选择器把打孔区左右互换做出来的，不靠你手工对页。
mantyke-game-notebook-skill.limit_zh: 它只解决排版：纸得你自己裁、孔得你自己打、活页夹自己买。输出路径写死在 /mnt/kimi/output/，是照 Kimi 沙箱写的，换别的 agent 要改。字体走 CDN 拉霞鹜文楷，打印前得先联网让它缓存好，Safari 打印还可能要调设置。
mantyke-game-notebook-skill.title_en: Odd pages punch left, even pages punch right
mantyke-game-notebook-skill.tagline_en: Your walkthrough lives on your phone and you keep switching away mid-game. This lays it out at 95 by 170 mm for a pocket binder, mirroring the punch margin so the holes line up after a long-edge flip.
mantyke-game-notebook-skill.why_en: Hole alignment on duplex printing comes from CSS odd/even page selectors swapping the punch zone left and right — not from you eyeballing the second pass.
mantyke-game-notebook-skill.limit_en: It only does layout: you cut the paper, punch the holes and buy the binder. The output path is hard-coded to a Kimi sandbox directory and needs changing on any other agent. The Chinese font loads from a CDN, so print only after it has cached, and Safari may need print settings adjusted.

rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.title_zh: 植被多就换品红键色，把照片做成能剪下来的贴纸页
rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.tagline_zh: 照片做成好看的图不难，难的是拿到一张真能打印、真能剪的透明贴纸。它一次交记忆卡和六枚图案的透明 PNG。
rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.why_zh: 去背走色度键，绿场景会撞色，所以植被多的图改用品红打底，最后还要验四角 alpha 是不是 0。
rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.limit_zh: 生图模型被写死成 seedream_5.0_pro，接不上这个模型的 agent 装了没用。贴纸恰好六枚、手写关键词恰好三个，都是定死的，不接受你要八枚。原图里的文字只在真的标识了地点时才留，广告、菜单、价格、时间戳一律剔掉。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文，装上后可能不被识别，改成英文更稳。
rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.title_en: Switches the chroma key to magenta when the photo is full of green
rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.tagline_en: Turning a photo into a pretty image is easy; getting a transparent sheet you can actually print and cut is not. This delivers a memory card and a six-motif transparent PNG together.
rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.why_en: Background removal runs on a chroma key, and green collides with foliage, so leafy photos are keyed on magenta instead — then all four corner alphas are verified as zero.
rollingalei-sticker-puzzle-photo-memory-.limit_en: The image model is hard-wired to one specific generator, so it is dead weight on an agent that cannot reach it. Six stickers and three handwritten keywords are fixed counts; asking for eight is not an option. Text from your photo survives only when it genuinely names a place — ads, menus, prices and timestamps are all stripped. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to ASCII.

veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.title_zh: 给玩偶眼睛定 90 牛拉力的毛绒版型设计台
veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.tagline_zh: 想缝一只自己设计的玩偶，卡在版型怎么拆。它按部件出版型图，标好缝份、毛向和对位点，还告诉你先缝哪一块。
veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.why_zh: 安全线是可量的：眼睛拉力 90N、接缝 70N、左右眼到鼻中线偏差不超 1mm，都写成收针前的自检项。
veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.limit_zh: 给 0–3 岁做的只能绣眼绣鼻、不许上铁丝，还要求过 GB 6675 全项——家里做不到就别当婴儿玩具送人。它给的是版型图和工序，不出 1:1 可直接打印的纸样，尺寸要你照标注自己放大。同仓另外两件是手办和拼装模型，不随这件走。
veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.title_en: Specs the eye pull test at 90 newtons before you sew
veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.tagline_en: You want to sew a doll of your own design and you are stuck on breaking it into pattern pieces. This issues a pattern per part with seam allowance, pile direction and notch marks, and tells you what to stitch first.
veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.why_en: Safety here is measurable: 90 N on the eyes, 70 N on the seams, under 1 mm asymmetry from each eye to the nose centreline, all written as checks before you close it up.
veriyoung-toy-design-skills-plush-doll-d.limit_en: For ages 0 to 3 it allows only embroidered eyes and nose, bans wire, and demands the full Chinese toy safety standard — if your kitchen table cannot meet that, do not give it to a baby. What you get is pattern drawings and a work order, not a printable 1:1 paper pattern; you scale from the marked dimensions yourself. The two sibling skills in the repo cover figures and model kits and do not come along.

lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.title_zh: 撞上滑块就停手、绝不替你出价的闲鱼蹲货员
lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.tagline_zh: 关键词、价格、地区筛完自动去重，最短半小时一轮盯上新，成色和信誉一律标成未知，不替你猜。
lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.why_zh: 同类爬虫都在装成人类，它写明遇到验证码就停、不换身份、不重复硬试。
lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.limit_zh: 只覆盖闲鱼一家。要在它单独开的浏览器里手动扫码登录，滑块也得你自己过；轮询最短 30 分钟，秒杀捡漏用不上；它不发消息、不下单、不付款。
lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.title_en: The Xianyu watcher that stops dead at the CAPTCHA instead of dodging it
lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.tagline_en: Recurring keyword searches on China's biggest used-goods market, with price and region filters, dedup across runs, and a hard 30-minute floor on polling.
lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.why_en: Its own rule: stop on risk control, do not bypass, do not rotate identity. Condition and seller reputation stay 'unknown' unless captured evidence proves them.
lenkin233-xianyu-monitor-skill.limit_en: Xianyu/Goofish only. You log in yourself in a dedicated Playwright window and clear any slider by hand; 30-minute minimum interval rules out flash-deal sniping; it never messages, bids, or pays.

googlarz-fashion-skill.title_zh: 站在试衣间里不许你说「再想想」的造型师
googlarz-fashion-skill.tagline_zh: 记住你的身形、色系和整个衣柜，出门前给两三套完整搭配，缺什么直接附购买链接和该看的尺码。
googlarz-fashion-skill.why_zh: 门店模式的硬规矩：别叫他回去想想，他站在试衣间里现在就要一个决定。
googlarz-fashion-skill.limit_zh: 购物链接只到 Zalando.de、Amazon.de 和 Vinted.de，德国以外基本用不上；导入订单、比价和上新提醒要 Chrome 桌面版；手机上装不了，只能靠它导一份文字摘要。
googlarz-fashion-skill.title_en: The stylist who refuses to let you 'think about it' in the fitting room
googlarz-fashion-skill.tagline_en: Learns your body, palette and entire wardrobe, then hands you two or three complete outfits — with a tested shop link and a size for whatever you're missing.
googlarz-fashion-skill.why_en: In-store mode is blunt on purpose: give a verdict first, never suggest they sleep on it, and say when €89 of fabric isn't worth it.
googlarz-fashion-skill.limit_en: Shop links are Zalando.de / Amazon.de / Vinted.de — outside Germany they're near useless. Order import, price alerts and brand watching need desktop Chrome. No mobile; you get an exported text summary instead.

2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.title_zh: 全图只许有一处不对劲的超现实拼贴台
2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.tagline_zh: 把你的照片去色留作现实锚点，背景换成两三块巨大平涂色形，再放进唯一一个不可能的巨物。
2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.why_zh: 禁止默认红日蓝天，禁止默认海豚鲸鱼：照抄参考图就是抄袭。
2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.limit_zh: 它只写提示词并调用你接的生图服务，成品好坏取决于那个模型；默认竖版 3:4；中文不许进 prompt（必乱码），文字要后期另排；纠偏只允许重生成一次。
2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.title_en: One impossible giant, and nothing else out of place
2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.tagline_en: Desaturates your photo into a black-and-white reality anchor, replaces the world behind it with two or three huge flat colour shapes, then drops in exactly one impossible object.
2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.why_en: The whole force of the surreal is that only one thing is wrong. A second impossible element gets deleted, and every colour must trace back to a hue already in your photo.
2998980-hue-surreal-pop-collage.limit_en: It writes the prompt and calls whatever image model you've wired up — output quality is that model's. Vertical 3:4 by default. Chinese text must be composited afterward, never put in the prompt. One retry only.

aryaminus-astro-astrology.title_zh: 拒绝凭记忆报出一个行星位置的占星师
aryaminus-astro-astrology.tagline_zh: 本地星历引擎实算西洋、印度和八字三套盘，再按古典规则解读，三套系统说法一致的地方才当结论。
aryaminus-astro-astrology.why_zh: 它给自己定的唯一底线：引擎算天空，你只负责读，绝不发明一个行星位置。
aryaminus-astro-astrology.limit_zh: 解读框架是占星传统，不是科学；明确拒绝彩票和赌球预测，健康只谈体质倾向并让你去看医生；要跑本地 Python 引擎，想要角秒精度和 Placidus 宫位得另装 pyswisseph。
aryaminus-astro-astrology.title_en: The astrologer that will not invent a planetary position
aryaminus-astro-astrology.tagline_en: Casts real charts — Western tropical, Vedic sidereal, Chinese BaZi — from a local ephemeris, then reads them against classical rulesets and treats agreement across traditions as its strongest signal.
aryaminus-astro-astrology.why_en: One rule separates it from every hallucinating chatbot: the engine computes the sky, you only read it. Gambling questions are refused outright.
aryaminus-astro-astrology.limit_en: The interpretation is tradition, not science. Health goes to body-tendency talk and a referral to a real doctor; no medication or treatment advice. Needs local Python; arcsecond precision requires installing pyswisseph.

hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.title_zh: 会替你删掉一半心愿单的行程地图生成器
hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.tagline_zh: 把零散截图和收藏整理成一天一片区的行程，查完点评和小红书，输出可点导航的单页交互地图。
hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.why_zh: 它认为你列的东西塞不进去，所以替你删；一天最多安排一个需要订位的地方。
hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.limit_zh: 调研环节绑死大众点评和小红书，非中文目的地信号很弱；要装第三方 OpenCLI 并自己开带调试端口的 Chrome；产出的地图是一份静态快照，行程当天不会自己更新。
hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.title_en: The itinerary that deletes half your wishlist for you
hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.tagline_en: Turns scattered screenshots and saved links into one-neighbourhood-per-day plans, checks dining signals, and ships a single-file interactive map with navigation and reservation buttons.
hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.why_en: It states plainly that not everything you listed fits, and deletes for you — one area per day, at most one reservation-required stop per day, and never bend a day around a famous restaurant that's off-route.
hiyeshu-trip-map-builder.limit_en: Research is wired to Dianping and Xiaohongshu, so non-Chinese destinations get thin signal. Needs the third-party OpenCLI plus a Chrome you launch with a debug port. The map is a static snapshot, not live.

emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.title_zh: 你一说出祖先名字它就拒绝立刻开搜
emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.tagline_zh: 先问你已知什么、想证明什么，排出档案优先级和检索策略，你点头之后才准动手查第一条记录。
emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.why_zh: 「绝对禁止未经要求的网络搜索」：它认为族谱的价值在方法，不在抢先翻出一张表。
emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.limit_zh: 方法与引用格式偏美国族谱学传统（Evidence Explained、GPS 五要素），资源首推 FamilySearch 与 LDSgenealogy；中文族谱、地方志和东亚档案基本不在它的地图里。
emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.title_en: Say an ancestor's name and it refuses to start searching
emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.tagline_en: Asks what you already know and what you're trying to prove, builds a prioritised research plan with citation and evidence-analysis templates, and only then executes searches — logging negative results too.
emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.why_en: It says the value of genealogy is systematic planning, not rushing to find records, and forbids unsolicited searching outright.
emaynard-claude-family-history-research-.limit_en: The method and citation style are US-genealogy tradition (Evidence Explained, the GPS five elements), and it points first at FamilySearch and LDSgenealogy. East Asian clan books and local gazetteers are outside its map.

surrealier-smartfileorganizer.title_zh: 默认绕开所有源码文件的下载目录整理器
surrealier-smartfileorganizer.tagline_zh: 读文件内容再重命名，乱码文件名逐个试编码救回来，全程留一张可以回滚的新旧对照表。
surrealier-smartfileorganizer.why_zh: 它默认不动代码：改名会毁掉 import 路径、include 指令和构建系统。
surrealier-smartfileorganizer.limit_zh: 超过 50 个文件会拆批交给子代理，并要求子代理免确认执行，第一次务必先在副本上跑；数据集目录靠「同后缀 100+ 个文件」这类启发式识别，识别到会先问你。
surrealier-smartfileorganizer.title_en: The file organiser that walks around your source code
surrealier-smartfileorganizer.tagline_en: Reads what's actually inside a file before renaming it, recovers mojibake names by trying EUC-KR / CP949 / Shift_JIS / GB2312 against the raw bytes, and keeps a rollback map the whole way.
surrealier-smartfileorganizer.why_en: It skips code by default, and says why: renaming breaks import paths, include directives and build systems. Datasets get flagged and asked about, not silently churned.
surrealier-smartfileorganizer.limit_en: Past 50 files it splits into sub-agent batches and asks them to run auto-approved — do your first run on a copy. Dataset detection is heuristic (100+ files sharing an extension, sequential names) and prompts you per directory.

orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.title_zh: 写明 WinSxS 只准 DISM 清的清理单
orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.tagline_zh: 按你是不是开发者、要不要保留休眠定制一份 PowerShell 脚本，先跑 DryRun，再逐项列出能腾出多少空间。
orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.why_zh: 一张「能不能删」对照表：WinSxS 只准 DISM 清理，永远不要手动删。
orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.limit_zh: 只管 Windows，macOS 和 Linux 用不上；脚本要管理员权限，关休眠、删还原点、清 WinSxS 都不可逆；中文系统必须存成带 BOM 的 UTF-8，否则脚本乱码。
orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.title_en: The C: drive cleanup that says WinSxS is DISM-only, never by hand
orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.tagline_en: Generates a PowerShell script tailored to whether you develop, whether you need hibernate, and which Chinese apps you run — with a dry-run mode and per-module skip flags.
orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.why_en: Its safe-to-remove table is the product: hiberfil.sys yes if you don't hibernate, Windows.old yes after the new OS proves out, WinSxS DISM-only and never manually.
orzcls-win-disk-cleaner.limit_en: Windows only. Needs admin, and hibernation, restore points and WinSxS cleanup are irreversible. On Chinese Windows the script must be saved as UTF-8 with BOM or it mangles.

jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.title_zh: 不让整段逐字稿挤进主对话的语音备忘录读取器
jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.tagline_zh: 只读 iCloud 同步过的语音备忘录数据库，从 m4a 的 tsrp 原子里取出苹果本机生成的转写并整理成笔记。
jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.why_zh: 转写故意交给子代理去取，就为了别让整段逐字稿占掉主对话的上下文。
jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.limit_zh: 只限开了 iCloud 同步的 macOS；转写是苹果在设备本机生成的，没有转写的录音它读不出来，也不会自己转写音频，只会明确告诉你 tsrp 原子找不到。
jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.title_en: The voice-memo reader that keeps the transcript out of your context
jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.tagline_en: Queries the CloudRecordings database read-only, then pulls Apple's on-device transcript straight out of the m4a's tsrp atom and turns it into notes with actions and asides.
jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.why_en: It spawns a sub-agent for the extraction on purpose — so a forty-minute transcript never lands in the main conversation.
jessedc-apple-voice-memos-apple-voice-me.limit_en: macOS with Voice Memos iCloud sync only. Transcripts are Apple's, generated on-device; recordings without one simply can't be read, and it will not transcribe audio itself.

realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.title_zh: 只说「不错」不说「你真棒」的 GTD 教练
realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.tagline_zh: 开场先静默体检收件箱条数、陈旧项和上次回顾距今几天，然后拿最难看的那个数字直接开口。
realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.why_zh: 语气规矩写得很死：可以说「不错」「这周挺稳」，不许说「你完成得真棒」。
realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.limit_zh: 只接 macOS 的 Apple 提醒事项和日历；脚本路径写成 .claude/skills/gtd/... 的相对路径，不在仓库目录里跑会找不到；它只做整理，决定还是你在提醒事项里点。
realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.title_en: The GTD coach allowed to say 'nice' but not 'great job'
realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.tagline_en: Runs a silent health check on inbox count, stale items and days since your last review, then opens on the worst number instead of narrating the check.
realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.why_en: The style rules are the product: do the organising, let the user decide, and brief warmth only — 'Nice.' or 'Solid week.', never 'Great job completing all those tasks!'
realyushi-my-gtd-buddy-gtd.limit_en: macOS Apple Reminders and Calendar only. Script paths are relative to .claude/skills/gtd/..., so it breaks outside the repo directory. It organises; you still make every call in Reminders.

ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.title_zh: 故意把综合健康分留成空值的健康报告
ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.tagline_zh: 本地解析 Apple 健康导出，出一份健康报告和一份训练报告，每条结论都必须引到具体数值或日期。
ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.why_zh: 复合评分字段一律留 null：不许用消费级设备的杂糅指标编一个健康总分。
ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.limit_zh: 要你自己从 iPhone 导出 zip 并装它的 npx 包；明确不做诊断、不推药物治疗或补剂剂量；睡眠分期、血氧、VO2max 一律当估计值；只有健康与训练两份报告，没有饮食营养。
ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.title_en: The health report that leaves the composite score deliberately null
ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.tagline_en: Parses your Apple Health export locally into structured insights, then writes two cross-linked HTML reports — health and training — where every conclusion has to cite a real number or date.
ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.why_en: compositeAssessment stays null on purpose: do not invent a single health score out of heterogeneous consumer-device metrics, and don't pretend to be a coach writing a periodised plan.
ruochenlyu-apple-health-analyst-apple-he.limit_en: You export the zip from your iPhone and install its npx package. It explicitly won't diagnose, name a condition, or recommend medication, treatment or supplement doses. Sleep stages, SpO2 and VO2max are treated as estimates. No nutrition.

alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.title_zh: 能按有没有防空空间筛餐厅的以色列订位助手
alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.tagline_zh: 一次跨多个日期、多家店查空位，看菜单和价位，最后给一条你自己去点确认的预订链接。
alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.why_zh: 它有个 --safe-zone 开关：按店里有没有「מרחב מוגן」防空空间来筛餐厅。
alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.limit_zh: 只覆盖以色列 27 个城市里上了 Ontopo 的餐厅；走的是官网背后的非公开接口，随时可能失效或与真实房态不符；它不替你订位，只生成链接。
alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.title_en: The Israeli table-finder with a bomb-shelter filter
alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.tagline_en: Sweeps availability across several dates and venues in one shot, reads menus with price filters, and hands back a booking link you confirm yourself.
alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.why_en: There's a --safe-zone flag that filters venues by whether they have a מרחב מוגן — a protected space. Nothing else on the shelf thinks about dinner that way.
alexpolonsky-agent-skill-ontopo.limit_en: Only venues on Ontopo, across 27 Israeli cities. It rides the site's undocumented internal API, which can break or lag real availability. It never places the reservation — it gives you the link.

duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.title_zh: 会打断你含糊用词的苏格拉底式陪练
duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.tagline_zh: 先把话题铺成一棵树，分清哪一层只是分支、哪一层才是研究者真在吵的分歧，然后一路反问你。
duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.why_zh: 分支和真分歧不是一回事：监督对自监督只是分支，数据越多是否伤泛化才是分歧。
duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.limit_zh: 它不给答案，只逼你想，急着要结论时会很难受；会话日记落在 diary/ 下；配套的文献综述依赖 Semantic Scholar 和联网搜索，没网时它会把整棵树标成未验证。
duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.title_en: The tutor that interrupts you for using a word loosely
duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.tagline_en: Maps your topic into a tree, separates the branches researchers agree on from the tensions they actually publish against each other over, and questions you down the path.
duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.why_en: Its distinction is the whole skill: supervised vs self-supervised is a branch; whether more data helps or amplifies spurious correlations is a tension. And a word used inconsistently is reasoning in quicksand.
duskyelf-teach-me-teach-me.limit_en: It won't hand you answers, which is genuinely uncomfortable when you're in a hurry. Session diaries land in diary/. The companion literature-review skill needs Semantic Scholar and web access; without it the tree is flagged unverified.

evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.title_zh: 认为页脚留白就是浪费考试资源的速查表
evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.tagline_zh: 读完你的课件和 PDF（图表还会渲成图再看一遍），压成一张多栏彩色 LaTeX 速查表，字号版式你定。
evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.why_zh: 它的密度规矩：底部留白等于浪费学生的考试资源，能塞就塞满。
evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.limit_zh: 输出是 XeLaTeX 源码，要 Overleaf 或本地 LaTeX 才编得出来；抽 PDF 和 PPTX 要 pymupdf 和 python-pptx；配置阶段会起一个本地网页表单；前提是你这门考试允许带速查表。
evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.title_en: The cheatsheet that treats white space at the bottom as waste
evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.tagline_en: Reads your slides and PDFs — rendering pages to images so it can actually see the diagrams — then compresses everything into one dense, colour-coded multi-column LaTeX sheet.
evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.why_en: Its density rule is stated outright: a cheatsheet with white space at the bottom is wasting the student's exam resource, so write as much as physically fits.
evan715823-cheatsheet-generator-skill-ch.limit_en: Output is XeLaTeX source; you need Overleaf or a local LaTeX install. Extraction needs pymupdf and python-pptx. Config runs through a local web form. And it assumes your exam actually allows a cheatsheet.

commithu502craft-professor-skill.title_zh: 把「这题上课讲过」蒸成一份期末自救包
commithu502craft-professor-skill.tagline_zh: 课件、真题、群里问答分两条线走：一条抽考试范围和给分偏好，一条抽这位老师的说话方式。
commithu502craft-professor-skill.why_zh: 分工写得很清楚：人格决定语气，课程大脑决定内容；玩笑只能来自认得出，不能是随口段子。
commithu502craft-professor-skill.limit_zh: 要你自己手里有课件和真题，材料薄它会明说置信度低；老师是真人，导入私聊记录和课堂录音你未必有权；它禁止把生成内容说成老师的正式通知或评分规则。
commithu502craft-professor-skill.title_en: Distils 'we covered this in class' into an exam rescue kit
commithu502craft-professor-skill.tagline_en: Splits your course materials into two engines — a Course Brain for exam scope, question patterns and grading preferences, and a Teacher Persona for how this specific lecturer actually talks.
commithu502craft-professor-skill.why_en: The division of labour is explicit: persona decides tone, Course Brain decides substance. And humour must come from recognition, never from random jokes.
commithu502craft-professor-skill.limit_en: You need real materials; thin input gets an honest low-confidence label. Your professor is a real person, and you may not have the right to ingest private chat logs or recordings. It refuses to pass output off as official notices or grading rules.

tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.title_zh: 先把你的问题答完才回头纠语法的英语教练
tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.tagline_zh: 每条回复三段：正常回答，五条以内的错误订正，一条轮换的新表达或语法点，重复犯的会被标成惯性错误。
tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.why_zh: 它先做正事：英语纠错是附赠，不是主菜；一次最多改五处，多了就说省略了几处小问题。
tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.limit_zh: 全文不到 3KB，没有脚本也没有进度存档，「适应你的水平」全靠同一段对话的上下文，换新会话就从零开始；只教英语对话，不适合代码审查和技术文档。
tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.title_en: The English coach that answers your question first
tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.tagline_en: Every reply has three parts: the actual answer, at most five corrections in strikethrough-to-bold form with a category tag, and one rotating thing to learn.
tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.why_en: It puts the coaching second on purpose — do your actual job first, the English is a bonus — and caps corrections at five so a reply never turns into a red-pen page.
tianmind-studio-english-coach-english-co.limit_en: Under 3KB, no scripts, no stored progress. 'Adapts to your level' means within one conversation; a new session starts cold. Conversation English only — explicitly not for code reviews or technical docs.

luchasarie-bro-skill.title_zh: 重讲一遍但一个数字都不许改的 /bro
luchasarie-bro-skill.tagline_zh: 上一条回答没看懂就打 /bro，它把自己刚说的话换成人话重说一次，不回答新问题、不查资料。
luchasarie-bro-skill.why_zh: 路径、命令、数字、URL 全部原样保留：只简化解释，不简化事实。
luchasarie-bro-skill.limit_zh: 全文 1.6KB，没有任何脚本；它只重述上一条助手消息，你要是想追问新东西它不接；对话里没有上一条时它只会说现在没什么可简化的。
luchasarie-bro-skill.title_en: Say it again, and don't touch a single number
luchasarie-bro-skill.tagline_en: Type /bro when the last answer didn't land, and it re-explains its own previous message like it's talking to a smart friend over a beer.
luchasarie-bro-skill.why_en: Every path, command, filename, number and URL survives verbatim — it simplifies the explanation around the facts, never the facts. And simpler doesn't mean shorter.
luchasarie-bro-skill.limit_en: 1.6KB, no scripts. It only re-expresses the previous assistant message: no new questions, no tools, no fresh information. With no prior message it just says there's nothing to simplify yet.

nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.title_zh: 题材加曲风不算完整需求的 Suno 词作台
nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.tagline_zh: 先访谈到段落结构、BPM、调性和声线都问清，再给一份歌词和一段可直接粘贴的风格提示词。
nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.why_zh: 硬停：需求薄的新歌第一轮绝不出成品，只回一份需求清单和追问。
nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.limit_zh: 只产歌词和风格提示词，不生成音频也不替你上传 Suno；流程很啰嗦，想随手要一首得明说要草稿；约 60 个参考文件里的声线库是描述性画像，不是特定歌手的授权音色。
nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.title_en: A topic plus a genre is not a complete brief
nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.tagline_en: Interviews you until section plan, BPM, key, vocal identity and vocal style are all actually decided, then delivers lyrics plus a paste-ready Suno style prompt.
nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.why_en: It hard-stops: for a new song from a thin brief, the first response is an intake snapshot and questions, never the finished four-section output. And it refuses to treat topic-plus-mood as enough.
nunaught-suno-songwriting-skill-suno-son.limit_en: Lyrics and prompts only — no audio, no uploading to Suno. The interview is long by design; ask for a sketch if you want speed. The ~60 reference files describe vocal characters, not licensed artist voices.

nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.title_zh: 分得清皮肤纹理和皮肤反光的写真提示词
nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.tagline_zh: 按妆容、发服、道具、构图、镜头、动作、光线的固定顺序推导，也能把参考图拆回可复用的词链。
nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.why_zh: 「真实皮肤微纹理」替代不了底妆干湿和 T 区油光，它按景别单独控反光范围。
nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.limit_zh: 默认只交付中文提示词、不主动生图；默认对象是成年年轻女性写真；同系列变体只固定风格与成像词链，构图动作每张重做，想要完全一致的连拍它给不了。
nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.title_en: It knows skin texture and skin reflection are different problems
nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.tagline_en: Derives portrait prompts in a fixed order — makeup, hair and wardrobe, props, composition, lens, pose, light, scene — or reverse-engineers a reference image back into a reusable keyword chain.
nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.why_en: 'Realistic micro skin texture' does not substitute for how wet the base makeup is or where the T-zone shines, so it controls highlight width per shot size instead of defaulting everything to matte.
nuyoah-ai-works-nuyoah-xiezhen-prompt.limit_en: Delivers Chinese prompts only and won't generate images unless asked. Default subject is an adult young woman. Series variants lock only style and imaging chains — composition and pose are redesigned each frame, so it can't give you an identical set.

neethanwu-ascii-art.title_zh: 先抢救剪贴板再问你要什么风格的 ASCII 台
neethanwu-ascii-art.tagline_zh: 文字、图片、视频都能转，九种风格四种抖动，可以导成 PNG、SVG、GIF 或带鼠标斥力的交互网页。
neethanwu-ascii-art.why_zh: 你粘一张图，它第一件事是从系统剪贴板抢存成文件：粘完那张图随时就没了。
neethanwu-ascii-art.limit_zh: 首次要跑一遍 setup.sh 建虚拟环境；视频要 ffmpeg 和 opencv；交互式和 React 导出只支持图片视频，纯文字不行；它明确不在终端里预览图像类结果。
neethanwu-ascii-art.title_en: It grabs the clipboard before it asks you anything
neethanwu-ascii-art.tagline_en: Turns text, images or video into ASCII with nine styles, four dithering algorithms, and exports to PNG, SVG, GIF, or an interactive page where the characters push away from your cursor.
neethanwu-ascii-art.why_en: When you paste an image, step one is saving it out of the system clipboard immediately — because a pasted image is gone the moment you do anything else.
neethanwu-ascii-art.limit_en: Run setup.sh once for the venv. Video needs ffmpeg and opencv. Interactive and TSX exports require image or video input, not text. It deliberately won't preview image results in the terminal.

qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.title_zh: 只写「她会怎么反应」不抄台词的角色蒸馏器
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.tagline_zh: 本地脚本检索萌娘百科等站点，五路并行调研，交叉验证后蒸出三到七条可执行的行为规则。
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.why_zh: 它抓的是她怎么行动，不是她说过什么：标签给人看，行为规则给 AI 执行。
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.limit_zh: 要 Python，且默认只跑最高保真模式，很费 token；来源黑名单排除知乎、公众号和百度百科；生成的角色包会写死资料截止日期，作品一出新剧情就得重跑。
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.title_en: It writes how she behaves, not what she said
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.tagline_en: Runs local scripted retrieval over character wikis, five parallel research agents, cross-validates every load-bearing claim, then distils three to seven executable behaviour rules.
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.why_en: The stated distinction: capture HOW she behaves, not WHAT she said — tags are for humans, behaviour rules are for the agent to run. Anything it can't ground stays a declared boundary.
qian-gugugaga-character_skill_producer.limit_en: Needs Python and runs highest-fidelity mode only, which burns tokens. Zhihu, WeChat articles and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources. Every generated pack stamps a data cutoff date and needs a rerun when the work updates.

flowful-ai-cad-skill.title_zh: 动一行几何代码之前先去查真实尺寸的建模台
flowful-ai-cad-skill.tagline_zh: 用 CadQuery 分三阶段建模，每阶段渲图给你看、等你反馈再往下，最后出 STL 和打印参数建议。
flowful-ai-cad-skill.why_zh: 接现实产品的尺寸一律去查、交叉两个来源：差一两毫米，这个零件就废了。
flowful-ai-cad-skill.limit_zh: CadQuery 只支持 Python 3.10–3.12，OCC 内核装不上得改走 conda；面向 FDM 功能件，不做渲染、雕刻和游戏资产，也不改你手里已有的 STL。
flowful-ai-cad-skill.title_en: It searches for real dimensions before writing a line of geometry
flowful-ai-cad-skill.tagline_en: Builds parametric CadQuery models in three phases, rendering a preview and waiting for your feedback at each one, and finishes with an STL plus print recommendations.
flowful-ai-cad-skill.why_en: For anything that has to fit a real product it searches for the spec and cross-references two sources, because even 1-2mm off makes the part unusable. And it refuses to disappear and come back with a finished model.
flowful-ai-cad-skill.limit_en: CadQuery needs Python 3.10-3.12; if the OCC kernel won't build you're on conda. Aimed at functional FDM parts — not rendering, sculpting, game assets, or editing an STL you already have.

serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.title_zh: 打叉之前必须先替对方辩护一轮的查证器
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.tagline_zh: 把视频、文章、推文或 PDF 拆成一条条主张，逐条联网核对，出一张带逐条判定和 0–10 分的报告卡。
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.why_zh: 快速模式只砍广度、绝不砍深度：仓促下的冤枉，仍然是冤枉。
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.limit_zh: 全量模式很慢很费 token，作者自己测过 35 次跑，第一次调工具前的纯思考能占掉 15%；必须能联网搜索，断网时结论不可用；报告是英文体例；它给证据链和分数，不是权威裁定。
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.title_en: It has to steelman a claim before it's allowed to reject it
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.tagline_en: Extracts the discrete claims from a video, article, tweet or PDF, verifies each against independent sources, and produces a report card with per-claim verdicts and an overall BS score.
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.why_en: Quick mode cuts breadth, never depth — because a fast false accusation is still a false accusation, and the steelman before any ❌ survives even the fastest run.
serhiikorniienko-bullshit-detector-bulls.limit_en: Full mode is slow and token-heavy; the author instrumented 35 runs and found 15% of all thinking happens before the first tool call. Needs live web search — offline verdicts are unusable. Reports are in English. It gives an evidence trail and a score, not a ruling.

xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.title_zh: 拒绝把「教你赚钱」的帖子当依据的副业侦察
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.tagline_zh: 只看招聘、采购、政策这类利益中立的需求信号反推机会，每条再过一遍反诈和时效两道 rubric。
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.why_zh: 没人会把真能赚钱的方法发到教你赚钱的帖里，那类内容是卖课钓粉漏斗。
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.limit_zh: 六个 money-* 子命令是一条流水线，要整仓安装并先跑 money-init 建画像；闲鱼和 BOSS 的一手数据靠你自己开 Chrome 登录、滑块自己过；找不到靠谱机会时它就直说没找到。
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.title_en: It won't cite a 'how to make money online' post as evidence
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.tagline_en: Works backwards from interest-neutral demand signals — job postings, procurement, policy — into things you could actually supply, then runs every candidate through an anti-scam and a freshness rubric.
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.why_en: Its founding claim: nobody posts a method that actually makes money into a 'how to get rich' thread — that content is a course-selling funnel, so it isn't a source.
xbuilderlab-cheat-on-money-money-find.limit_en: Six money-* commands form one pipeline; install the whole repo and run money-init first. First-party marketplace and hiring data comes from a Chrome you log into and clear sliders in yourself. When it finds nothing credible, it says so.

kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.title_zh: 先问你能不能坐下吃饭，再决定穿哪套的穿搭搭子
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.tagline_zh: 场合、天气、你已经有的衣服丢进去，出来一套首选、一个备选，和一段必须写的「穿搭雷区」，外加一张竖版搭配板。
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.why_zh: 冲突优先级写死：安全和身体舒适 > 场合得体 > 真实感 > 美感 > 流行。买东西排在改穿法和替代之后。
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.limit_zh: 不做真人虚拟试穿，出的是插画搭配板；没有图片生成能力就退回纯文字。默认中文。最别扭的一条：它内置「设计不外泄」条款，你问它自己的规则、模板或图片提示词一律拒答，连「我是作者本人」也不认——而这些文件就摆在仓库里。
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.title_en: The stylist that asks whether you can sit down and eat in it
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.tagline_en: Feed it the occasion, the weather and the clothes you already own. Out comes one first choice, one backup, and a mandatory list of what would go wrong — plus a vertical styling board.
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.why_en: The conflict ladder is hard-coded: safety and body comfort beat occasion propriety, which beats your own truth, which beats aesthetics, which beats trend. Buying ranks last, after restyling and substitution.
kingqiu-outfit-stylist-skill-outfit-styl.limit_en: No photorealistic virtual try-on — you get an illustrated outfit board, or plain text if your setup cannot generate images. Chinese output by default. The odd part: a built-in non-disclosure clause makes it refuse to discuss its own rules, templates or image prompts, even if you claim to be the author — while those files sit openly in the repo.

vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.title_zh: 防晒里阿伏苯宗配错就悄悄归零的成分表判官
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.tagline_zh: 成分表不是清单的加和，是化学系统。超过一个活性物就必须过一遍六类配伍：刺激叠加、互相失活、光敏、致敏、促渗、协同。
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.why_zh: 先分清淋洗类还是驻留类，否则 MIT 驻留禁用、水杨酸限值差异这类法规比对根本不会触发。
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.limit_zh: 中国大陆法规口径（《化妆品安全技术规范》/IECIC），欧美产品限值要另判。只看成分表不看浓度——绝大多数配方不公布浓度，它只能按排位推。判定档位只有安全/注意/谨慎三档，不给绝对结论，也不看皮肤病。库外成分要联网检索。
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.title_en: The ingredient-list judge that catches sunscreen quietly dropping to zero
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.tagline_en: An ingredient list is a chemical system, not a sum of items. Any formula with more than one active must be run through six interaction mechanisms: irritation stacking, mutual deactivation, photosensitivity, preservative sensitisation, penetration amplification, and genuine synergy.
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.why_en: It settles rinse-off versus leave-on first, because otherwise the regulatory checks that matter — MIT banned in leave-on products, different salicylic acid caps — never fire at all.
vange-wang-ingredient-decision-skill.limit_en: Built on mainland China regulation (Safety and Technical Standards for Cosmetics, IECIC); EU and US limits need separate judgement. It reads the list, not the concentrations — almost no brand publishes those, so it can only infer from ordering. Verdicts come in three bands only, never absolutes, and it will not read a skin condition. Ingredients outside its bundled library need a web lookup.

hermess-skincare-product-selector.title_zh: 备案号没查到就不给最终结论的护肤选品官
hermess-skincare-product-selector.tagline_zh: 二选一、多候选排序、按需挑选、成分表审查。先拿备案号去 NMPA 查现行配方，再用官方渠道核价，最后给一句买或不买。
hermess-skincare-product-selector.why_zh: 大陆产品 0.1% 以下、美国 1% 以下的成分可以不按顺序排——数位次前先分清是哪个市场。
hermess-skincare-product-selector.limit_zh: SKILL.md 把脚本路径写成了作者本人的 /Users/caifeiya/…，得自己换成你的 skill 目录。抓不到页面时它会老实标「受阻」并让你用 Chrome 自己打开，明确拒绝绕验证码——也就是说不少时候要你手动补证据或拍包装照。价格只认官方旗舰和大平台。
hermess-skincare-product-selector.title_en: The skincare picker that refuses a verdict without a filing number
hermess-skincare-product-selector.tagline_en: Four modes: A-versus-B, ranking a shortlist, building a pool from your skin and budget, or auditing one ingredient list. It pulls the current formula from the NMPA filing, prices it from official channels, then commits to buy or skip.
hermess-skincare-product-selector.why_en: In mainland China anything at or below 0.1% may be listed out of order; in the US the cutoff is 1%. So it establishes which market version you hold before it reads anything into ingredient position.
hermess-skincare-product-selector.limit_en: SKILL.md hard-codes the author's own /Users/caifeiya/… script paths — swap in your skill directory. When a page blocks it, it labels the source blocked and asks you to open it in Chrome yourself; it explicitly refuses to defeat CAPTCHAs, which means you will often be supplying screenshots or packaging photos. Price evidence is limited to official stores and major platforms.

yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.title_zh: 把「定金」和「订金」两个字掰开算钱的维权翻译机
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.tagline_zh: 你说「公司无故辞退我」，它输出能提交的仲裁申诉文本，附证据清单、维权路径和赔偿估算。覆盖劳动、租房、预付卡等 15 类。
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.why_zh: 误区表逐条对撞常识：定金不退订金可退，食品假货是退一赔十，2N 和 N 不能同时主张。
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.limit_zh: 中国大陆法律，条文和赔偿标准会随司法解释变动，正文明写不构成法律意见、不替代律师。赔偿计算器只给区间，各省的一次性伤残就业补助金标准要你自己查。合同逐条解读这一块和在架的 AnythingButLaw 有重叠。
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.title_en: The grievance translator that pries apart two nearly identical Chinese words for deposit
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.tagline_en: Say "my company fired me for no reason" and it hands back a filable arbitration statement, plus the evidence you need to keep, the route to take, and a compensation range. Fifteen domains, from labour to tenancy to prepaid cards that vanished.
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.why_en: Its misconception table collides with common sense line by line: one kind of deposit is forfeit and the other refundable, counterfeit food pays ten times over, and you cannot claim both severance and the double-damages figure.
yunpeng192-legal-language-bridge.limit_en: Mainland Chinese law only, and the statutes and compensation standards shift with judicial interpretation — the skill states outright that it is not legal advice and no substitute for a lawyer. The calculator gives ranges; province-specific disability employment subsidies you look up yourself. Its clause-by-clause contract reading overlaps with AnythingButLaw, already on the shelf.

senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.title_zh: 门禁被关了也让你去打卡，被拦就报警拿回执
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.tagline_zh: 公司停你岗、降你薪、关你门禁，它不劝你忍。今天去打卡留痕，本周寄出恢复劳动条件通知书，再按 2N 而不是 N 算钱。
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.why_zh: 给建议前先查判例的胜诉与败诉模式：你没满足的列进补证据清单，你踩了的先改。录音只认你自己在场的那种。
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.limit_zh: 只做上海——社平工资、三倍封顶、各区仲裁委电话、医疗期标准全是上海口径，外地得自己换数。数据标注 2025–2026，政策年度一换就要核。它站员工这边，不给公司合规建议。和在架 arb-skill 在「辞退后算钱」这段重叠，它更早一步，从软裁员开始。
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.title_en: It tells you to go badge in even after they killed your access, and to call the police if you are blocked
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.tagline_en: When the company benches you, cuts your pay and shuts off your badge, this does not tell you to sit tight. Clock in today for the record, send the formal demand letter this week, then compute the money at double severance rather than single.
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.why_en: Before advising, it checks the win and loss patterns in comparable rulings: what you have not satisfied becomes your evidence to-do list, and what you have tripped over gets corrected first. It only counts recordings of conversations you were part of.
senzhang88-socialist-workers-power-work-.limit_en: Shanghai only — the average-wage base, the triple-wage cap, the district arbitration phone numbers and the medical-leave standards are all local, so elsewhere you substitute your own numbers. Data is marked 2025–2026 and needs rechecking each policy year. It argues for the employee and offers employers nothing. Its post-dismissal math overlaps with arb-skill on the shelf; this one starts earlier, at the quiet squeeze-out.

lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.title_zh: 不许把「建议改造」写成「已完成」的简历项目侦察兵
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.tagline_zh: 它不替你写简历。它从 GitHub 挑一个你真该动手改的业务系统，clone 到本地读源码，再告诉你哪几条能写进简历。
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.why_zh: star 过 1k 就不再因更高而加分；本地 clone 不成功、源码里抠不出 5 个证据点的一律淘汰。
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.limit_zh: 只服务后端（Java/Spring、分布式）和业务型 AI Agent 两个方向，默认排除 IoT 与嵌入式；前端、算法、非技术岗用不上。它交的不是文档而是工程作业——推荐的项目你得真去改，是几周的活。必须联网、必须 git clone，你不先选一种推荐模式它就不动。
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.title_en: The resume project scout that will not let a plan be written up as done
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.tagline_en: It does not write your resume. It goes out to GitHub, finds one complete business system worth your actually modifying, clones it locally to read the source, then tells you which bullets you can already claim and which you have to build first.
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.why_en: Past a thousand stars, more stars earn nothing extra. Any candidate it cannot clone locally, or from whose source it cannot extract five concrete evidence points, is eliminated outright.
lishuangqiang-backend-agent-resume-scout.limit_en: Scoped to backend work (Java/Spring, distributed systems) and business-grade AI agents, with IoT and embedded excluded by default — no use for frontend, algorithms or non-technical roles. What it delivers is homework, not a document: the project it picks is weeks of real work. It needs the network, needs git clone, and refuses to start until you pick one of its recommendation modes.

sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.title_zh: 说完数字就闭嘴，别自己补一句「不行也没关系」
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.tagline_zh: 提加薪、提离职、给下属负反馈、跟父母谈催婚、跟伴侣分家务。没谈的替你排练，谈崩的替你复盘，写好没敢发的那段替你改两版。
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.why_zh: 改写只给两版并各标代价，逼你想清要的是一个态度还是一个日期——前者对方给不了也不想给。
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.limit_zh: 只给文字，不代发。遇到家暴、人身威胁、自伤，它明确不套用自己那套工具（前提是双方安全对等，此处不成立），先给安全预案和 12338，并告诉你对方停不停手不取决于你的措辞。劳动仲裁只帮你准备怎么说。和在架的非暴力沟通教练在「怎么开口」上有交集。
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.title_en: Say the number, then stop talking — do not add "of course it's fine if you can't"
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.tagline_en: Asking for a raise, resigning, delivering bad feedback, fending off parents about marriage, splitting housework. It rehearses the conversation you have not had, autopsies the one that blew up, and rewrites the message you drafted but could not send.
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.why_en: Rewrites always come in two versions with the cost of each spelled out, which forces you to decide whether you want an attitude or a date — because the first is something the other person cannot and will not give.
sunxin-ai-crucial-conversations.limit_en: Text only; it never sends anything for you. For domestic violence, threats or self-harm it explicitly refuses to apply its own toolkit — those tools assume two parties are safe and equal — and instead gives a safety plan, a hotline, and the line that whether the other person stops is not decided by your wording. For arbitration it only helps you prepare what to say. Overlaps with the nonviolent-communication coach already on the shelf.

bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.title_zh: 结算单上要写一行「旧件归还」的汽修防坑参谋
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.tagline_zh: 报价拆成配件费和工时费分开看，先问能不能修再谈总成更换，旧件必须带走。每条诊断都标自查、到店，还是立即停驶。
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.why_zh: 敲击金属声加机油灯直接判立即停驶，继续开会拉缸；反复打火每次别超 10 秒、间隔至少 30 秒。
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.limit_zh: 价格区间是中国大陆普通合资/国产车口径，豪华车上浮 50%–150%，而且没标采集日期，会过时。自查方法限于车主无工具能做的，需要举升机和诊断仪的它只让你去店里。不替代专业维修，高压电、气囊、刹车总泵一律劝你别碰。
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.title_en: The repair-shop chaperone that makes you write "old parts returned" on the invoice
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.tagline_en: Split the quote into parts and labour and read them separately, ask whether it can be repaired before you accept a whole-assembly swap, and take the removed parts home with you. Every diagnosis is tagged: check it yourself, get to a shop soon, or stop driving now.
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.why_en: A metallic knock plus the oil light means stop driving immediately — keep going and you scuff the cylinder. And when it will not start: never crank longer than ten seconds, wait at least thirty between tries.
bettermen-car-repair-skill-car-repair.limit_en: Price bands are for ordinary joint-venture and domestic cars in mainland China, with luxury marques running 50–150% higher, and no capture date is given, so they will drift. Self-checks are limited to what an owner can do without tools; anything needing a lift or a scanner is sent straight to a shop. It is not a substitute for a mechanic and tells you to keep away from high-voltage packs, airbags and brake master cylinders.

johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.title_zh: OCR 抠出来的数不许参与涨跌判定的体检趋势台
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.tagline_zh: 把历年体检报告（电子 PDF、扫描件、手机拍的照片）解析成指标时间序列，标出异常和趋好趋坏，出报告加一张离线工作台。
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.why_zh: 异常判定用当年报告自带的参考范围，不跨年套统一值——试剂一换，直接胆红素的上下限就变了。
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.limit_zh: 电子版解析的列坐标是照某一家体检机构的版式实测出来的，换机构要先自己确认列边界。照片版靠 macOS Vision OCR，非 Mac 走不了这条路，而且照片里的中文识别率不到一半。给的是分层建议和就医指征，不给诊断也不给药。
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.title_en: The checkup trend desk that bars OCR-scraped numbers from any change verdict
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.tagline_en: It parses years of health checkup reports — text PDFs, scans, even phone photos — into one indicator time series, flags what is abnormal, what moved significantly, and which way it is heading, then ships a report and an offline dashboard.
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.why_en: Abnormality is judged against the reference range printed on that year's own report, never a single range imposed across years — swap the reagent and the direct bilirubin bounds move with it.
johnsmithca-sta-health-report-trend-anal.limit_en: The column coordinates for text PDFs were measured against one particular clinic's layout, so a different provider means confirming the boundaries yourself first. The photo path runs on macOS Vision OCR, which rules out non-Mac machines, and Chinese recognition on photos lands under fifty percent. You get tiered lifestyle guidance and referral thresholds — no diagnosis, no drugs.
